1.title: Yintoni iSabelo?
1.content: Khawufane ucinge: wena nabahlobo abali-9 nifaka {c}10 ngamnye ukuze nithenge iitekkies ze-{c}100 kunye. Ngamnye kuni ungumnini we-1/10 yezo tekkies, kwaye leyo, ngokusisiseko, yisabelo! Xa uthenga isabelo kwa-{retail}, uba ngumnini wesuntswana levenkile nganye, lemveliso nganye, nayo yonke {cName} abayenzayo. Okukhona inkampani ikhula, kokukhona isabelo sakho sixabiseka ngakumbi! 🔥

quiz.q: Wena nabahlobo aba-4 nahlulelana ngokulinganayo iindleko zesitulo sokudlala se-{c}500. Ngamnye kuni ungumnini wantoni?
quiz.explanation: Ukuba ngumnini wesabelo kuthetha ukuba ngumnini wenxalenye yento iphela. Abahlawuli abahlanu abalinganayo bathetha amasuntswana amahlanu alinganayo, kwaye isuntswana ngalinye linamalungelo afanayo nawamanye.
options: 1/5 (20%) yesitulo umntu ngamnye
Akukho nto, ngumntu omnye kuphela onokuba ngumnini waso
Isitulo siphela kunye, kungekho sabelo somntu ngamnye

2.title: I-{ex} Ichaziwe
2.content: Cinga nge-{ex} ({exFull}) njengemarike enkulu ekwi-intanethi, kodwa endaweni yokuthenga iitekkies okanye iifowuni, abantu bathenga baze bathengise amasuntswana (izabelo) eenkampani ezifana no-{top5}. Ivulekile yonke imihla yeveki ngaphandle kweeholide zikawonke-wonke, kwaye amaxabiso ayatshintsha imini yonke ngokuxhomekeke kubantu abathengayo nabathengisayo. I-{ex} {exDesc}! 🌍

quiz.q: I-{ex} ifana kakhulu nantoni?
quiz.explanation: Iqonga lezabelo lidibanisa abantu abafuna ukuthenga izabelo nabantu abafuna ukuzithengisa. Alingomnini wezabelo, alikhethi ixabiso, kwaye aliyi kukuhlawula inzala ngokushiya imali apho.
options: Imarike, apho abanini bezabelo badibana nabathengi
Iakhawunti yokonga, apho imali ihlala khona ize ifumane inzala
Ivenkile engumnini wezabelo ize ikuthengisele zona

3.title: Iinkunzi neeBhere
3.content:
Kwiimarike, zizilwanyana eziqhuba izinto 😄

🐂 Inkunzi = amaxabiso ANYUKAYO. Cinga ngenkunzi ehlaba ngeempondo isiya phezulu. Wonke umntu uyaphumelela, abantu bayathenga, imeko intle.

🐻 Ibhere = amaxabiso AYEHLAYO. Cinga ngebhere ebetha ngentende isiya ezantsi. Abantu boyika, bayathengisa, ayilotyeli lilungileyo.

Xa umntu esithi 'ndi-bullish nge-{tech}', ucinga ukuba ixabiso liza kunyuka. Xa esithi 'ndi-bearish', ucinga ukuba liya ezantsi. Uza kuwava la magama yonke indawo kwezemali!

quiz.q: Umhlobo wakho uthi: 'Ndi-bearish nge-{telco} kule veki.' Kuthetha ntoni oko?
quiz.explanation: I-bearish ithetha ukulindela ukuba ixabiso lehle, i-bullish ithetha ukulindela ukuba linyuke. Ibhere ibetha isiya ezantsi, inkunzi iphosa isiya phezulu.
options: Ucinga ukuba ixabiso lika-{telco} liza kunyuka
Ucinga ukuba ixabiso lika-{telco} liza kwehla
Ufuna ukuthenga u-{telco} omninzi kangangoko

4.title: Yintoni iBhrokha?
4.content:
Awunakuvele ungene kwa-{retail} uthi 'ndicela undinike inxalenye yenkampani yakho' 😂 Ufuna ibhrokha: i-app okanye inkonzo edibanisa abathengi nabathengisi kwiqonga lezabelo.

Cinga ngebhrokha njenge-{shop}. Ufuna into, i-{shop} ikudibanisa nayo. Yona iqhuba intengiselwano ize ibize umrhumo omncinci. Iibhrokha ezidumileyo e{name} ziquka u-{broker} nezinye.

Nantsi into ibhrokha ENGAYENZIYO: ukugqiba ukuba zeziphi izabelo eziya kunyuka. Yona idlulisela umyalelo wakho emarikeni. Ixabiso lishukuma ngenxa yoko kuthengwa nokuthengiswa ngabantu bonke phaya, kungekhona ngenxa yokuba ibhrokha yakho itshilo.

Noko ke, iibhrokha ziyazipapasha izimvo zazo. Abahlalutyi bazo banika izabelo isigqibo sokuthi 'thenga', 'bamba' okanye 'thengisa'. Uluvo ayingomyalelo 🤷 Abahlalutyi bayaphikisana ngokuphandle omnye nomnye ngesabelo esinye kanye, kwaye abaninzi kubo baphela bengachananga. Funda isigqibo sabo njengoluvo, kungekhona njengomthetho.

I-NoobTrader ikufundisa kanye indlela oku okusebenza ngayo, simahla, ngemali yokuzilolonga!

quiz.q: Kutheni ufuna ibhrokha ukuze uthenge izabelo?
quiz.explanation: Ibhrokha yindlela yakho yokungena kwiqonga lezabelo, ayingomxeli-kamva kwaye ayingomntu omisela amaxabiso. Idlulisela umyalelo, kwaye ixabiso lelo imarike yonke ikulungeleyo ukurhweba ngalo. Abahlalutyi bayo bapapasha izigqibo, kodwa isigqibo luluvo, asingomyalelo.
options: Ikhetha izabelo eziza kunyuka
Imisela ixabiso olihlawulayo kwisabelo ngasinye
Idlulisela umyalelo wakho kwiqonga lezabelo

5.title: Izisekelo zeXabiso leSabelo
5.content:
Wakhe waqaphela indlela iitekkies ezikhutshwe zambalwa ezinyuka ngayo ixabiso xa ziphuma? Kwenzeka into efanayo kwizabelo. Konke kusekuboneleleni nakwimfuno.

📈 Abantu abaninzi BAFUNA ukuthenga → ixabiso LIYANYUKA
📉 Abantu abaninzi BAFUNA ukuthengisa → ixabiso LIYEHLA

Ukuba u-{telco} ubhengeza ukuba ufumana abathengi abatsha abazizigidi ezili-10, wonke umntu ufuna isuntswana, ngoko ixabiso liyadubula. Ukuba banika ingxelo yelahleko enkulu, abantu bathengisa bengcangcazela, ngoko ixabiso liyehla. Iindaba, iziphumo, kwanezinto ezitrendayo kwi-social media zinokushukumisa amaxabiso ezabelo ngoko nangoko!

quiz.q: U-{retail} ubhengeza inzuzo ephakame ngaphezu kwazo zonke kunye nezicwangciso zokuvula iivenkile ezintsha ezingama-50. Kwenzeka ntoni mhlawumbi kwixabiso lesabelo sabo?
quiz.explanation: Inzuzo elindelekileyo engcono idla ngokuthetha abathengi abaninzi, kwaye abathengi abaninzi batyhala ixabiso phezulu. Ukusebenzisa imali ukuze ukhule akufani nokuyimosha.
options: Liyanyuka njengoko abantu abaninzi befuna ukuthenga
Lihlala lilelo kanye
Liyawa kuba bechitha imali kwiivenkile

6.title: Ukufunda iTshathi leXabiso
6.content:
Itshathi lexabiso lifana nevidiyo emfutshane yezona zinto ziphambili ezenzekileyo kwimbali yesabelo. Olona hlobo ludumileyo litshathi lamakhandlela. Ikhandlela ngalinye likubonisa izinto ezi-4 zosuku olunye:

🟢 Ikhandlela eliluhlaza = ixabiso LINYUKILE ngaloo mini (livule lisezantsi, lavala liphezulu)
🔴 Ikhandlela elibomvu = ixabiso LEHLILE (livule liphezulu, lavala lisezantsi)
📏 Imigca emincinci engentla nengezantsi = elona xabiso liphezulu nelona lisezantsi losuku

Ukuba ubona amakhandlela amaninzi aluhlaza elandelelana, olo lutyekelo olunamandla olunyukayo. Amaninzi abomvu athetha utyekelo olwehlayo. Ukufunda ukuwafunda amatshathi kufana nokufunda ibhodi yamanqaku emdlalweni! 🎮

quiz.q: Ubona amakhandlela abomvu ama-5 elandelelana kwitshathi. Oku kukuxelela ntoni?
quiz.explanation: Ikhandlela elibomvu livala ngaphantsi kwalapho livule khona, ngoko amahlanu elandelelana ziiseshoni ezintlanu zokwehla. Umbala ukuxelela icala, hayi ubukhulu boshukumo.
options: Isabelo besinyuka iintsuku ezi-5
Isabelo besisehla iintsuku ezi-5
Ixabiso lesabelo alitshintshanga

7.title: Umthamo Nokuba Ukuxelela Ntoni
7.content:
Umthamo = zingaphi izabelo ezithengwe zaza zathengiswa ngosuku. Cinga ngawo njengokubukelwa kwevidiyo ye-TikTok.

🔊 Umthamo OPHEZULU = abantu abaninzi bayarhweba. Ukuba ixabiso lishukuma kunye nomthamo ophezulu, lowo ngumqondiso onamandla nothembeke ngakumbi, njengevidiyo ehamba ngenene, ingekho iibhothi.

🔇 Umthamo OSEZANTSI = ngabantu abambalwa kuphela abarhwebayo. Amaxabiso anokushukuma ngendlela engaqhelekanga xa umthamo usezantsi, njengevidiyo ebukelwe kathathu kuphela eyabelwana ngempazamo.

Soloko ujonga umthamo xa ubona ushukumo olukhulu lwexabiso. Lukuxelela ukuba olo shukumo lolwenene okanye yingxolo nje!

quiz.q: Isabelo sika-{telco} sitsibe nge-5% namhlanje, kodwa umthamo usezantsi kakhulu. Kufuneka ucinge ntoni?
quiz.explanation: Umthamo ubonisa ukuba kukho ukuzithemba okungakanani emva koshukumo. Ukutsiba okukhulu ngorhwebo oluncinci kakhulu kunokubuyela umva lula njengoko kwenzekileyo, ngoko jonga umthamo phambi kokuba ukholelwe ukuqhekeza (breakout).
options: Ngokuqinisekileyo leli lelona thuba likhulu, thenga ngoku!
Umthamo osezantsi uhlala uthetha ukuba ixabiso liza kuqhubeka linyuka
Olo shukumo lusenokungathembeki, umthamo osezantsi wenza ukuba lukrokreleke

8.title: Inkxaso Nomqobo
8.content:
Yenza umfanekiso wokuba ixabiso lesabelo yibhola edlobayo:

🧱 INKXASO = umgangatho ibhola edlobela kuwo. Ixabiso lihlala lisehla kodwa qho xa lifika kweli nqanaba, litsiba libuyele phezulu. Abathengi abaninzi bavela apha.

🪟 UMQOBO = usilingi ibhola ebetha kuyo. Qho xa ixabiso linyukela kweli nqanaba, lityhalelwa emva ezantsi. Abathengisi abaninzi bathatha imali yabo apha.

Abarhwebi basebenzisa la manqanaba njengemephu yomdlalo: thenga kufuphi nomgangatho, thengisa kufuphi nosilingi. Xa ixabiso ekugqibeleni lityhala ludlule kumqobo, lidla ngokunyuka ngesantya. Xa liqhawula inkxaso, zilungiselele ukuwa! 💥

Sinye isilumkiso esinyanisekileyo: la manqanaba azotywa ngabantu abajonge amatshathi, ayingomithetho ekufuneka imarike iyithobele. Isabelo sinokudlula sitshabalalise 'inkxaso' siqhubeke sihamba. 📉

quiz.q: Isabelo sidlobe kwi-{c}50 izihlandlo ezithathu ngaphandle kokuhla ngaphantsi kwayo. Ibizwa ntoni i-{c}50?
quiz.explanation: Umgangatho ohlala uhlonitshwa yinkxaso; usilingi ohlala uligxotha ixabiso ngumqobo. Akukho nanye kuzo isisithembiso, kodwa zombini kufanelekile ukuzazi phambi kokuba uthenge.
options: Inqanaba lenkxaso
Inqanaba lomqobo
Ixabiso losilingi

9.title: Ukusasaza uTyalo-mali
9.desc: Musa ukubeka onke amaqanda kubhasikithi omnye
9.content:
Khawucinge ngokuchitha YONKE i-data yakho kwi-app enye yokubukela. Emva koko loo app iyaphuma. Usale ungenanto. 😩

Kodwa ukuba usasaza i-data yakho kuWhatsApp, kuYouTube, NAKWI-app yakho yokubukela, enye ephumayo ayonakalisi usuku lwakho lonke.

Kuyafana nasekutyaleni imali! Ukuba ufaka YONKE imali yakho kwisabelo esinye size siwe, ulahlekelwa yiyo yonke into. Kodwa ukuba uyisasaza ku-{telco} (unxibelelwano), ku-{retail} (iivenkile), ku-{tech} (itekhnoloji), nakwi-ETF, ukuwa kwesinye akuyitshabalalisi yonke iphothifoliyo yakho. Eli qhinga lokusasaza libizwa ngokuba KUKUSASAZA UTYALO-MALI. 💼

quiz.q: Une-{c}500 yokutyala. Yeyiphi kwezi ewusasaza ngokwenene umngcipheko wakho?
quiz.explanation: Iivenkile ezintlanu zempahla zonke zinyuka zisihla ngenxa yento enye, ngoko imali esasazwe kuzo ayisasazekanga kwaphela. Amashishini ahlukeneyo afikelwa ziingxaki ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo, kwaye yiloo nto ethintela isiphumo esinye esibi ukuba sithathe yonke into.
options: I-{c}100 nganye kwiivenkile ezintlanu ezahlukeneyo zempahla
I-{c}100 nganye kumashishini amahlanu ahlukeneyo
Yonke i-{c}500 kwinkampani enye oyithanda kakhulu

10.title: Umngcipheko Nomvuzo
10.content:
Wakhe wathenga ibhokisi ongazi ukuba kukho ntoni ngaphakathi? Usenokufumana into emangalisayo, okanye inkunkuma nje. Lowo ngumngcipheko ophezulu / umvuzo ophezulu.

Ukutyala imali kusebenza ngendlela efanayo:

✅ UMNGCIPHEKO OSEZANTSI, UMVUZO OSEZANTSI: Njengo-{retail}: inkampani enkulu, esekwe kakuhle. Imali yakho idla ngokukhula kancinci kodwa ngokuzinzileyo. Qaphela 'osezantsi', kungekhona 'ongekhoyo'. Iinkampani ezinkulu nazo ziyawa.

🎲 UMNGCIPHEKO OPHEZULU, UMVUZO OPHEZULU: Njengenkampani entsha encinci yemigodi. Inokuphindwa kalishumi, okanye inyamalale. Njengaloo bhokisi ungayaziyo.

Phambi kokuba utyale imali kuyo nayiphi na into, soloko uzibuza: 'Yeyiphi eyona nto imbi inokwenzeka?' Ukuba awukwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kwaloo mali, sukuwuthatha loo mngcipheko!

quiz.q: Ingqekembe (coin) ekungekho mntu wakhe weva ngayo ithembisa imbuyekezo ye-500%. Isithembiso esikhulu kangako sikuxelela ntoni ngenene?
quiz.explanation: Umngcipheko nomvuzo ziziphelo ezibini zentonga enye. Akukho mntu unika i-500% ngelize, ngoko ubukhulu besithembiso eneneni bulinganisa ukuba isixa sonke sinokunyamalala lula kangakanani. Phambi kokuba ufake imali kuyo nayiphi na into, buza ukuba eyona meko imbi ijongeka njani nokuba ungaphila nayo na.
options: Yinto etshiphu imarike yonke engakhange iyiqaphele ngandlela ithile
Okukhona isithembiso sikhulu, kokukhona abantu abangemva kwaso benyanisekile
Ithuba lokulahlekelwa yiyo yonke into likhulu njengesithembiso

11.title: Ixesha Elide Nexesha Elifutshane
11.content:
🏃 UKURHWEBA KWIXESHA ELIFUTSHANE: Ukuthenga nokuthengisa phakathi kweentsuku okanye iiveki ukubamba ushukumo olukhawulezayo lwexabiso. Uxinzelelo oluphezulu, kufuna ixesha elininzi ujonge iscreen. Kufana nokuzama ukuqikelela ukuba ngubani oza kuphumelela kumdlalo ngamnye kwitumente.

🧘 UKUTYALA IMALI KWIXESHA ELIDE: Ukuthenga izabelo uze uzibambe iminyaka. Uyanyamezela xa zisehla uze uyeke imali yakho ikhule. Kufana nokubheja ukuba liliphi iqela eliza kuphumelela lonke usizini. Akothuki emva komdlalo omnye ombi.

Uphando ngeeakhawunti zokwenene zeebhrokha luhlala lufumana into efanayo: okukhona abantu berhweba rhoqo, kokukhona besilela ngakumbi xa sele kubalwe iindleko.

Kwaye ixesha lelona thuba elingenakuthengwa kamva. Unyaka ngamnye imali ehlala ityaliwe ngomnye unyaka wokuba inzala edibeneyo isebenze. ⏳

quiz.q: Abantu ababini bathenga izabelo ezifanayo ngemali efanayo. Omnye uthenga athengise veki nganye, omnye uzishiya zingaphazanyiswa iminyaka elishumi. Uphando ngeeakhawunti zokwenene luhlala lufumana ntoni?
quiz.explanation: Intengiselwano nganye ibiza into ethile, kwaye loo ndleko iyaphuma nokuba intengiselwano iphumelele okanye ayiphumelelanga. Uphando emva kophando ngeeakhawunti zokwenene zeebhrokha lufumana into efanayo: okukhona abantu berhweba rhoqo, kokukhona begqiba besemva. Ukushiya imali ingaphazanyiswa ayikokonqena, sisicwangciso esitshiphu.
options: Lo uxakekileyo udla ngokusala ngasemva xa sele kubalwe iindleko
Lo uxakekileyo udla ngokuphumelela, kuba umzamo uyavuzwa apha
Bagqiba belingana, kuba babambe kanye izabelo ezifanayo

Kususa iimvakalelo ekutyaleni imali kuba akusoze kufuneke ugqibe ukuba 'ngaba NGOKU lelona xesha lifanelekileyo?' Uyazibophelela nje uhambe! 💪

Ilizwi elithe ngqo: oku akusoze kuhlale kubetha ukufaka imali yonke ngaxeshanye. Into oyenzayo kukwenza isicwangciso onokuthi unamathele kuso ngokwenene.

quiz.q: Ufaka i-200 NT xa isabelo sibiza i-100 NT. Emva koko isabelo siyawa, kwaye i-200 NT yakho elandelayo ingena kwi-25 NT. Rhuqa uye kwixabiso lakho eliphakathi kwisabelo ngasinye kwiintlawulo ezimbini.
quiz.explanation: I-200 NT yakho yokuqala ithenge izabelo ezi-2 nge-100 NT. I-200 NT yakho yesibini ithenge izabelo ezi-8 nge-25 NT. Yi-400 NT yezabelo ezili-10, ngoko yi-40 NT nganye. Qaphela ukuba ayikho kwanakufuphi nesiqingatha phakathi kwala maxabiso mabini: imali efanayo ngokuzenzekelayo ithenga ngakumbi xa izinto zitshiphu, kwaye yiloo nto erhuqela ixabiso lakho eliphakathi ezantsi.

13.title: Iintsana zeMali 💸
13.content:
Khawufane ucinge ukuba unomatshini othengisa izidlo. Veki nganye, abantu bathenga izidlo KUMATSHINI WAKHO, wena uqokelele imali, ngenxa nje yokuba ungumnini wawo. Bekungekho nto yongezelelweyo ekufuneke uyenzile!

Ziyiloo nto ke iidividendi. Sizibiza ngokuba ziiNtsana zeMali 🍼 kuba imali yakho ngokwenene izala iintsana: iintlawulo ezincinci zemali ezifika kwiakhawunti yakho ngenxa nje yokuba unezabelo.

Iinkampani ezinkulu ezifana no-{divPayers} zihlawula iiNtsana zeMali rhoqo. Okukhona unezabelo ezininzi, kokukhona iintsana zakho zisiba zininzi!

⚠️ AZIQINISEKISWANGA. Inkampani igqiba ngalo lonke ixesha ukuba iyahlawula na, kwaye inokuyinciphisa idividendi okanye iyiyeke ngokupheleleyo xa ishishini linzima. Intlawulo enkulu kulo nyaka ayisosithembiso senye kunyaka olandelayo.

Kwaye ukuba ezo ntsana uyaziphinda uzityale ukuze uthenge izabelo EZININZI... umqulu wakho olandelayo mkhulu ngakumbi. Sisijikelezo esihle 🔁

quiz.q: U-{bank} ukuhlawula i-{c}5 kwisabelo ngasinye onaso, ungakhange uthengise nto. Ibizwa ntoni loo ntlawulo?
quiz.explanation: Idividendi yinxalenye yenzuzo yenkampani enikwa abantu abangabanini bayo. Le app iyibiza ngokuba ziiNtsana zeMali. Uhlala nazo zonke izabelo obunazo, kwaye imali isafika kwiakhawunti yakho. Kodwa ayithenjiswanga, kwaye inkampani inokuyinciphisa okanye iyiyeke nanini na xa ishishini linzima.
options: Idividendi, isuntswana lenzuzo
Inzala, efana naleyo ihlawulwa yiakhawunti yokonga
Ibhonasi yokuthembeka ngokuba ngumthengi

14.title: Inzala Edibeneyo
14.desc: Indlela imali yakho ekhula ngayo ngokwayo
14.content:
Nayi eyona mfihlelo yemali inamandla oza kuze uyifunde. Ulungile? 👀

Utyala i-{c}1,000 nge-10% ngonyaka:
• Unyaka 1: {c}1,000 → {c}1,100 (ufumene {c}100)
• Unyaka 2: {c}1,100 → {c}1,210 (ufumene {c}110, ngaphezu konyaka 1!)
• Unyaka 3: {c}1,210 → {c}1,331 (ufumene {c}121)

Ngoku ufumana inzala KWINZALA yakho. Ibhola yekhephu ikhula minyaka le ungongezanga nto. Emva kweminyaka engama-30 nge-10%? Loo {c}1,000 iba yi-{c}17,449! 🤯

Uza kubona oku kubizwa ngokuba 'ngummangaliso wesibhozo wehlabathi' kubalelwa kuEinstein. Abukho ubungqina bokwenene bokuba wakha wakutsho, kodwa yimathematika ebalulekileyo, kwaye imathematika iyinyani. Qala kwangethuba, ixesha likwenzela umsebenzi onzima.

quiz.q: Ufaka i-2,000 NT nge-10% ngonyaka kwaye awuze uyichukumise. Rhuqa uye kwixabiso layo emva kweminyaka emithathu.
quiz.explanation: Unyaka wokuqala wongeza i-200 NT, nto leyo eyenza i-2,200. Unyaka wesibini uthatha i-10% ye-2,200, ngoko wongeza i-220 kwaye wenza i-2,420. Unyaka wesithathu wongeza i-242 uze ufike kwi-2,662. Unyaka ngamnye i-10% ibalwa kwimfumba enkulu, yiyo loo nto ukongeza i-200 kathathu uze ume kwi-2,600 kusilela.

15.title: Inzala Edibeneyo Nezabelo
15.desc: Ukuphinda utyale iiNtsana zeMali ukuze ukhule

19.title: Imiyalelo yokuMisa iLahleko
19.content:
Isimisi-lahleko sifana nokubeka umda wokuba ufuna ukulahlekelwa kangakanani: ngumnatha wokhuseleko owubeka kwangaphambili.

Umzekelo: Uthenga izabelo ze-{telco} nge-{c}100 ngasinye. Ugqiba ukuba AWUFUNI ukulahlekelwa ngaphezu kwe-15%. Ngoko ke umisela isimisi-lahleko kwi-{c}85.

Ukuba u-{telco} wehla afike kwi-{c}85 → umyalelo wokuthengisa uyaziqhusheka ngokuzenzekelayo. Akufuneki ube ubukele, kwaye akufuneki wenze isigqibo ngelixa ungcangcazela.

Nantsi indawo abantu abayiphosisayo. Inani lesimisi-lahleko lihlala LINGEZANTSI kwexabiso lanamhlanje. Kufuneka kube njalo, kuba ixabiso kufuneka lehle ukuze lifike kulo. Libeke ngentla kwexabiso lanamhlanje kwaye sele liyinyani, ngoko lithengisa kwangoko xa ulibekile, ngexabiso lanamhlanje. Oko kukuthengisa, ayingomnatha wokhuseleko.

Musa ukuyixuba nokuthengisa ngomda. Zombini zithengisa ngokuzenzekelayo ngexabiso olikhethileyo. Umahluko licala: isimisi-lahleko siqhushumba xa ixabiso LISEHLA lifike kwinani lakho, ukuthengisa ngomda kuqhushumba xa LINYUKA lifike kwinani lakho. Ukuzikhusela → inani lakho liya ezantsi. Ukuchaza ixabiso lakho → inani lakho liya phezulu. Zibuze ukuba wenza eyiphi phambi kokuba uchwetheze. 🧭

⚠️ Into enkulu: isimisi-lahleko siqhusheka UKUTHENGISA, asiliqinisekisi IXABISO. Ukuba kufika iindaba ezimbi ebusuku size isabelo sivule kwi-{c}70 singazange sirhwetshwe kwi-{c}85, umyalelo wakho uzaliseka nangayiphi na imali imarike eza kuyihlawula ngokwenene. Loo nto inokuba ngaphantsi kakhulu kwenqanaba olibekileyo.

Ungenaso konke konke isimisi-lahleko, usenokubambelela ulindele ukuba sichache... uze usibukele sisehla siya kwi-{c}20. 😬

Icebo lengcali: Soloko ugqiba ngeyona lahleko inkulu unokuyithwala PHAMBI kokuba uthenge. Musa ukuvumela imvakalelo yenze eso sigqibo xa ixabiso sele lisiwa! 🧘

quiz.explanation: I-15% ye-200 NT yi-30 NT, ngoko indawo yakho yokuphuma ingama-30 ngaphantsi kwalapho uthenge khona, kwi-170 NT. Sibeke ngentla kwaye sele siyinyani, ngoko sithengisa ngoko nangoko xa usibekile, kwaye oko kukuthengisa endaweni yomnatha wokhuseleko.

20.title: Xa Kufuneka Uthenge Uze Uthengise
20.content:

• Kutheni ndithenga le nto? (uphando, kungekhona umdla nje)

• Ndiza kuthengisa ngaliphi ixabiso ukuba LIYEHLA? (isimisi-lahleko)

23.title: Ukufunda iZiphumo zeNkampani
23.content:

💰 INZUZO ESELEYO: Okuseleyo EMVA kokuhlawula zonke iindleko. Yiyo imali eshiyekayo ekupheleni kosuku.
📈 I-EPS (Ingeniso kwiSabelo ngaSinye): Inzuzo yahlulwe ngenani lezabelo. Ingakanani imali efunyenwe sisabelo ngasinye.

Imiqondiso emihle: Ingeniso INYUKA + Inzuzo INYUKA + I-EPS iyakhula = 🟢 ixabiso lidla ngokunyuka
Imiqondiso emibi: Ingeniso IYEHLA + Inzuzo iyehla = 🔴 ixabiso lidla ngokwehla

Nantsi into: eyona nto ishukumisa ixabiso sisiphumo xa sithelekiswa noko imarike YAYIKULINDELE. Amanani amahle afike ngaphantsi koko bekulindelwe asenokusithumela isabelo ezantsi.

37.content:
Amandla amakhulu e-crypto akwangumngcipheko wayo: iintengiselwano azinakubuyiselwa umva kwaye akukho bhanki inokuyilungisa impazamo. Abaqhetsebi bayakuthanda oko. Nasi isixhobo sakho sokuzikhusela:

🔐 AMAGAMA AKHO EMBEWU AYINGCWELE. Akakho umntu osemthethweni oza KUZE awacele. Hayi 'abasebenzi benkxaso', hayi 'ibhothi yokuqinisekisa', akakho. Nabani na ocela amagama akho embewu uyakubela, kuphelile apho.

🎣 UKUDOBA: iiwebhusayithi nemiyalezo yobuxoki ebonakala kanye njengamaqonga okwenene. Unobumba omnye owahlukileyo kwidilesi yewebhu. Soloko uyibhala ngokwakho idilesi.

🎁 UBUQHETSEBA BEZIPHO: 'Thumela ingqekeza enye, ufumane ezimbini!', ngokufuthi besebenzisa iakhawunti egqekeziweyo yomntu odumileyo. Akakho ophinda kabini imali yakho. Nakanye.

💕 UBUQHETSEBA BOTHANDO NOBOMCEBISI 'WOTYALO-MALI': umntu ongaziwayo onobubele okuthethelela ngokuthe chu ukuba uye 'kwiqonga elikhethekileyo'. Iqonga lobuxoki. Ukukhupha imali akusebenzi.

Indlela ephantsi kwabo bonke ubuqhetseba: ukungxamiseka kunye nemfihlo kunye nenzuzo eqinisekisiweyo. Xa ubona ezo zinto zintathu kunye, hamba uyeke. 🚶

quiz.q: Umntu othi 'yinkxaso yeqonga' ukuthumelela umyalezo ecela amagama akho embewu ali-12 ukuze 'aqinisekise isipaji sakho'. Wenza ntoni?
quiz.explanation: Amagama embewu NGASO isipaji. Nabani na owaphetheyo angasikhupha sonke, inkxaso yokwenene ayize iwacele, kwaye akukho nxalenye yawo ekufuneka kwabelwane ngayo.
options: Ungaze wabelane ngawo, kuba inkxaso yokwenene ayize iwacele amagama embewu
Wabelane ngawo, kuba abasebenzi benkxaso abaqinisekisiweyo bayawadinga ukujonga iakhawunti yakho
Wabelane ngamagama amathandathu okuqala kuphela, akhuselekile ngokwaneleyo ngokwawo
Bacele ukuba baqale bakuthumelele i-imeyile evela kwidilesi esemthethweni, uze wabelane ngawo

38.title: IBhosi ye-Crypto
38.content:
Lifikile ixesha lebali elicatshulwa ngumntu wonke kodwa lingaxelwa kakuhle namnye.

Ekuqaleni kuka-2017, i-Bitcoin enye yayibiza malunga ne-$1,000. NgoDisemba ka-2024 yagqitha kwi-$100,000 okokuqala. Ukuthenga kwe-$1,000, ukubanjwa yonke loo ndlela, kwaba malunga ne-$100,000. Oko kukuphindwa kalikhulu. 🤯

Nantsi ke inxalenye eshiywa ngumdla: ukuze uqokelele oko kuphindwa kalikhulu kwafuneka uhlale phakathi kokuwa okubini okumasikizi, okunye malunga nama-84% okunye malunga nama-77%, uze ubukele imali yakho incipha IMINYAKA ngexesha ungathengisi. Phantse akakho owakwazi ukuyenza loo nto. Uninzi lwabantu lwathenga phezulu, lwangcangcazela ekuweni, lwaza lwathengisa ezantsi.

Kwaye kwi-Bitcoin nganye kukho amawaka eengqekeza ezifileyo eziye kwiqanda. Ukukhetha ophumeleleyo kwangaphambili kubonakala kulula xa ujonga umva kuphela. Oko kubizwa ngokuba kukukhetha abasindileyo kuphela, kwaye yeyona nkohliso ibiza kakhulu kwi-crypto.

Esona sifundo somatshini wexesha: kwiingqekeza ezasindayo, umonde wabetha ukukhetha ixesha. Kodwa ufumanisa ukuba zeziphi iingqekeza ezisindayo EMVA nje kokwenzeka, yiyo loo nto ukusasaza kubetha ukukhetha iqhawe elinye, kwaye kungoko kungekho MNTU oyaziyo ikamva. Kwanebhosi ngokwayo. 🐉
38.bossVictory: Icandelo le-crypto loyisiwe. Ngoku wazi ngaphezu kwabantu abadala abaninzi. 🐉

quiz.q: Amawaka eengqekeza asungulwa kunye ne-Bitcoin, kwaye uninzi lwazo ngoku aluxabisi nto. Kutheni ukuthi "khetha nje i-Bitcoin elandelayo" kubonakala kulula kangaka xa ujonga umva?
quiz.explanation: Ngabasindileyo kuphela abasathethwa ngabo, ngoko ukukhetha abaphumeleleyo kubonakala kulula kakhulu xa ujonga umva kunokuba kwakunjalo ngelo xesha. Amawaka asilelayo akashiyanga mkhondo ebalini.
options: Kuba ngabaphumeleleyo kuphela abasathethwa ngabo, kwaye ezo zafayo zanyamalala ebalini
Kuba ezona ngqekeza zilungileyo zicaca kwasekuqaleni kuye nabani na ofunda ngokwaneleyo ngazo
Kuba uninzi lweengqekeza lugqibela lulungile kuye nabani na onomonde wokuzibamba iminyaka
Kuba oochwepheshe bayiqikelela kakuhle i-Bitcoin ngo-2010 kwaye baqikelele bonke abaphumeleleyo ukusukela oko

39.title: Iyintoni Ngokwenene iBlockchain?
39.content:
Susa umdla ogqithisileyo uze ubone ukuba i-blockchain ilula ngokumangalisayo: yincwadi yerekhodi eyabelwanwayo eneekopi ezifanayo ezigcinwa ziikhompyutha ezingamawaka.

Xa umntu ethumela i-crypto, loo ntengiselwano ingena 'kwibhloko' kunye namakhulu amanye. Ibhloko itywinwa ngemathematika ize ikhonkxwe kwibhloko engaphambili. Kungoko ke: block. Chain. ⛓️

Kutheni umntu ekhathala? Ngenxa yoko ikwenza kube nokwenzeka:

✅ Akakho onokuyihlela imbali ngokuzolileyo. Ukutshintsha ibhloko endala kuya kuthetha ukwenza kwakhona zonke iibhloko ezilandelayo kwiikhompyutha ezingamawaka ngaxeshanye.
✅ Ayikho inkampani enye okanye urhulumente oyiqhubayo. Uthungelwano lweekhompyutha luyiqhuba kunye.
✅ Nabani na unokujonga irekhodi. Yonke intengiselwano ye-Bitcoin eyakha yenziwa iyabonwa esidlangalaleni.

Leyo yitekhnoloji entsha ngokwenene. Kwakhona AYISIYOMALI yemilingo. Irekhodi egqibeleleyo yengqekeza engenaxabiso isengqekeza engenaxabiso. Ukuba itekhnoloji iyinyani akwenzi ukuba yonke ingqekeza eyakhelwe kuyo ibe nexabiso. 🧠

quiz.q: Kutheni kunzima kangaka ukutshintsha ngokufihlakeleyo intengiselwano endala kwi-blockchain?
quiz.explanation: Ibhloko nganye itywinwe kwengaphambili kwayo, ngoko ukubhala kwakhona endala kuthetha ukubhala kwakhona zonke iibhloko ezilandelayo, kwiikhompyutha ezingamawaka, ngokukhawuleza kunokuba uthungelwano longeza ezintsha. Yiyo loo nto irekhodi isisigxina phantse.
options: Zonke iibhloko ezilandelayo bekuya kufuneka zenziwe kwakhona
Utshintsho ngalunye kufuneka luvunywe ngurhulumente
Yonke irekhodi endala kunenyanga iyacinywa
Umdali wengqekeza nganye ugcina isitshixo sokuhlela esiyimfihlo

40.title: I-Bitcoin Nazo Zonke Ezinye
40.content:
'I-Crypto' ayisiyonto inye. Umahluko ubaluleke ngaphezu kokufana:

₿ I-BITCOIN: yeyokuqala. Isibonelelo sayo simiselwe kwizigidi ezingama-21 zeengqekeza ngonaphakade, kubhaliwe kwikhowudi, kwaye izinga leengqekeza ezintsha lehla ngesiqingatha malunga neminyaka emine nganye. (Kuvakala kwaziwa? Ukwehla ngesiqingatha kwe-NOOB kuboleke kanye le ngcinga.) Yonke into ezikhankanya ngayo kukunqaba kunye nokhuseleko.

⟠ I-ETHEREUM: ayisiyo 'igolide yedijithali' kangako, ngu-'khompyutha wehlabathi' ngakumbi. Iqhuba izivumelwano ezikrelekrele, eziziinkqubo ezizenzekelayo. Uninzi lwee-app ze-crypto zakhelwe kuyo okanye kubakhuphisani bayo.

🪙 ZONKE EZINYE: amawaka ee-'altcoin'. Ezimbalwa zisombulula iingxaki zokwenene. Uninzi zizikopi, ngamalinge, okanye kukuqwenga imali. Inani elikhohlakeleyo: uninzi lweengqekeza ezakha zadalwa sele zifile okanye zingenaxabiso.

Isifundo: ukuthi 'i-crypto iyanyuka' akukuxeleli nto phantse ngayo NAYIPHI NA ingqekeza ethile. Nganye yibhethi yayo, inamathuba ayo. 🎲

quiz.q: Sithini isibonelelo esiphezulu se-Bitcoin, kwaye kulula kangakanani ukusitshintsha?
quiz.explanation: Umda wezigidi ezingama-21 uyinxalenye yemithetho eqhutywa yikhompyutha nganye kuthungelwano. Ukuwunyusa bekuya kuthetha ukuba phantse zonke zivumelane ukwenza oko sele zikuphethe kuxabiseke ngaphantsi, yiyo loo nto umda uthathwa njengomisiweyo.
options: Izigidi ezili-100, kwaye abambi bavota ngayo minyaka le
Izigidi ezingama-21, kwaye ukuyinyusa phantse akunakwenzeka
Isigidigidi esi-1, kwaye umdali unokuyitshintsha
Akukho mda kwaphela, ngoko iingqekeza ezintsha ziprintwa ngonaphakade

41.title: Iingqekeza Ezizinzileyo
41.content:
Ingqekeza ezinzileyo yi-crypto eyilelwe ukuba ihlale ixabisa isixa esimiselweyo, ngokuqhelekileyo idola elinye lase-US kanye. Abarhwebi bazisebenzisa njengendawo yokupaka: thengisa iingqekeza zakho eziguquguqukayo uzifake kwingqekeza ezinzileyo, imali yakho ihlale ngxi ngelixa ugqiba inyathelo elilandelayo.

Zihlala njani kwi-$1? Uyilo oluphambili lugcina iidola nezinto zokwenene kubuncwane, ukuze ingqekeza nganye ixhaswe yinto ethile. Uthemba lowo ubambe obo buncwane.

Nali ke ibali lakho lokulumkisa: iingqekeza ezizinzileyo zinako UKWAPHUKA. Kwenzekile ngokwenene. Ngo-2022 ingqekeza enkulu ezinzileyo 'ye-algorithm', eyayisebenzisa imathematika ekrelekrele endaweni yobuncwane bokwenene, yawa isuka kwi-$1 yaya phantse kwiqanda kwiintsuku ezimbalwa yaza yatshabalalisa amashumi eebhiliyoni zeedola. 'Ukuzinza' yinjongo yoyilo, ayisosiqinisekiso.

Umthetho oqhelekileyo: okukhona indlela egcina into 'ikhuselekile' ikrelekrele, kokukhona kufuneka uyijonge ngengqalelo. 🔍

quiz.q: Uyintoni owona msebenzi uphambili wengqekeza ezinzileyo?
quiz.explanation: Umsebenzi wengqekeza ezinzileyo kukuhlala ngxi. Yindawo yokupaka phakathi kweentengiselwano, ayiyonto ilindeleke ukuba ikhule.
options: Ukubamba ixabiso elimiselweyo, ngokuqhelekileyo i-$1, ukuze abarhwebi babe nendawo ezinzileyo yokupaka
Ukukhula ngokukhawuleza kune-Bitcoin ngokulandela yonke imarike ye-crypto
Ukuhlawula inzala ngokuzenzekelayo kuye nabani na oyigcine kwisipaji
Ukufihla iintengiselwano kuwo wonke umntu ngokubhida irejista yoluntu

42.title: I-Crypto, iRhafu Nomthetho
42.content:
I-intanethi izele ngabantu abakholelwa ukuba i-crypto yimali engabonakaliyo engenamithetho. Badla ngokufumanisa ngendlela enzima. 😬

Inyani kumazwe amaninzi, kuquka uMzantsi Afrika:

🧾 INZUZO IDLA NGOKURHAFISWA. Thengisa i-crypto ngaphezu koko wawukuhlawulile, ize igunya lerhafu lifune isabelo salo, njengakwizabelo.

🪪 AMAQONGA AYAZI UKUBA UNGUBANI. Amaqonga asemthethweni afuna ukuqinisekiswa kwesazisi (kubizwa ngokuba yi-KYC, Yazi uMthengi wakho). Intengiselwano nganye ikwarekhodwa ngokusisigxina kwi-blockchain ngokwayo, into leyo ECHASENE NCAM nokungaziwa.

⚖️ ABALAWULI BABANDAKANYEKILE. EMzantsi Afrika, izinto ze-crypto ziphathwa ngokusesikweni njengeemveliso zemali, oko kuthetha ukuba amaqonga azithengisayo kufuneka alandele imithetho yeenkonzo zemali.

Akukho nanye kwezi nto isisizathu sokuba wothuke. YISIZATHU sokungawahoyi amazwi omntu othi 'imithetho ayisebenzi kwi-crypto'. Iyasebenza, kwaye ukwenza ngathi ayisebenzi kufaka abantu abadala engxakini enkulu ngokwenene.

quiz.q: Umzala wakho uthi inzuzo ye-crypto ayibonakali kwigunya lerhafu kuba i-crypto ayaziwa ukuba yeyabani. Yintoni engalunganga ngoko?
quiz.explanation: Amaqonga asemthethweni ayaqinisekisa ukuba ungubani phambi kokuba urhwebe, kwaye intengiselwano nganye kwi-blockchain ivulelekile kwaye ihlala ngonaphakade, into echasene ncam nokungaziwa. Inzuzo idla ngokurhafiswa, ngoko jonga imithetho apho uhlala khona.
options: Amaqonga ajonga isazisi, kwaye iirekhodi zivulelekile
Akukho nto, i-crypto ayaziwa ngokwenene
I-crypto irhafiswa eMelika kuphela, akukho kwenye indawo
Irhafu iqala xa urhoxisa isigidi

43.title: Ukuguquguquka Nemithetho Yokusinda
43.content:
Usuku olubi kwimarike yezabelo lulu-3%. Usuku olubi kwi-crypto lungama-20%. Kwa-Bitcoin, 'umdala' we-crypto, ilahlekelwe ngaphezu kwe-80% yexabiso layo ngaphezu kwesihlandlo esinye yaza yachacha kamva. Iingqekeza ezincinci zilahlekelwa yi-95% rhoqo zize zingaze zibuye.

Kutheni ziqhwalela kangaka? I-crypto irhwetshwa yonke imizuzu yosuku ngaphandle kwezimisi, uninzi lwayo ithengwa ngemali ebolekiweyo enyanzelwa ukuba ithengiswe xa kusiwa, kwaye amaxabiso aqhutywa ngamabali neemvakalelo ngaphezu kweengxelo zenzuzo.

Nantsi ke imithetho yokusinda, ephindwa ngumrhwebi ngamnye onamava:

1️⃣ Ungaze ufake imali ongakwaziyo ukuyilahla ngokupheleleyo.
2️⃣ Yenza izikhundla zakho zibe ngangobukhulu obungenakuthi intlekele enye ikucime.
3️⃣ Gqiba ngendlela yakho yokuphuma PHAMBI kokuba ungene, ngelixa uzolile.
4️⃣ Ukoyika ukushiyeka yeyona mvakalelo ibiza kakhulu kwezemali.

Ziqhelanise nayo yomine kwi-NoobTrader apho iilahleko zizezokudlala. Imikhwa yiyo eyona mbasa. 🏆

quiz.q: Yeyiphi kwezi ngumthetho wokwenene wokusinda kwiimarike eziguquguqukayo?
quiz.explanation: Ukungaze ubeke emngciphekweni imali ongakwaziyo ukuyilahla ngumthetho omnye okugcina usemdlalweni. Ukuphinda kabini emva kwelahleko yindlela ii-akhawunti eziphela ngayo.
options: Phinda kabini isikhundla sakho emva kwelahleko nganye ukuze uyibuyise
Ungaze utyale imali ongakwaziyo ukuyilahla ngokupheleleyo
Ukuguquguquka kuchaphazela iingqekeza ezincinci kuphela, ngoko ezinkulu zikhuselekile
Soloko uthenga xa wonke umntu kwi-social media ethenga

44.title: Imijikelezo Yomdla Nokoyika Ukushiyeka
44.content:
I-crypto ihamba ngemijikelezo yomdla, kwaye xa sele uyibona le ndlela awusayi kuze uyilibale:

📈 Isigaba 1: kwenzeka into yokwenene. Abakholwayo bokuqala bayathenga bethe cwaka.
🚀 Isigaba 2: amaxabiso ayanyuka. Amajelo eendaba ayaqaphela. Ifidi yakho izala ngabaphumeleleyo.
🎪 Isigaba 3: ukubhidakala. Abaqhubi beeteksi banika amacebo ngeengqekeza. Abantu bayaboleka ukuze bathenge. 'Eli xesha lahlukile.'
💥 Isigaba 4: ukuwa. Abafike mva, abathenge ngokona kuphezulu, balahlekelwa kakhulu.
🕳️ Isigaba 5: ukuthula. Iiposti zabaphumeleleyo ziyanyamalala. Akakho othetha ngeelahleko zakhe.

Ukuqhambuka kwee-NFT ngo-2021 kwalandela le nto kanye: izinto zokuqokelela zedijithali zithengiswa ngezigidi phezulu, kwaye kwiminyaka embalwa emva koko uninzi lwazo lwaluxabisa phantse into engekhoyo.

Iqhinga elikhohlakeleyo lako konke ukubhidakala: lenza ELONA xesha LIBI lokuthenga livakale njengelona lingxamisekileyo lokuthenga. Xa kuvakala kukhuseleke kakhulu ukungena, kuba wonke umntu sele engenile, inzuzo elula idla ngokuba sele iphelile. 🎯

quiz.q: Kumjikelezo womdla oqhelekileyo, umntu oqhelekileyo uziva enomnqweno omkhulu wokuthenga nini?
quiz.explanation: Umnqweno uvakala kakhulu xa ibali livakala kakhulu, kwaye ibali livakala kakhulu emva kokuba ixabiso sele linyukile. Ukuba wonke umntu engenile kwenza kuvakale kukhuselekile, kwaye kukwayinto eshiya kungekho mntu useleyo ukuba athenge.
options: Ekuqaleni, xa phantse kungekho mntu uthetha ngako
Phakathi ekuweni, xa amaxabiso esezantsi
Kufuphi nencopho, xa wonke umntu sele engenile
Akulandeli ndlela, umnqweno uvela nje ngamabona-ndenzile

45.title: Ukufunda iKhandlela
45.content: Ikhandlela ngalinye libalisa ibali elincinci ngamanani amane kuphela: apho ixabiso livule khona, elona liphezulu elifikelele kulo, elona lisezantsi liwele kulo, nalapho livale khona. Umzimba oqinileyo usuka ekuvuleni ude uye ekuvaleni, kwaye umbala ukuxelela ukuba ngubani ophumeleleyo: oluhlaza luthetha ukuba ukuvala kugqibele kungentla kokuvula, obomvu buthetha ukuba abathengisi balitsalele ezantsi. Lelo lonke iqhinga. Funda ukulifunda kakuhle ikhandlela elinye uze wonke umzobo ehlabathini utshintshe usuka kudonga lwengxolo ube libali lemifanekiso. 🟢

quiz.q: Eli khandlela liluhlaza. Likuxelela ntoni ngelo xesha lokurhweba?
options: Ixabiso livale ngaphantsi kokuba livulile
Abantu abaninzi bathengile kunabathengisileyo, kuqinisekisiwe
Ixabiso livale ngaphezu kokuba livulile
Ixabiso alizange lehle kwelo xesha

46.title: Iintambo Zibalisa Amabali
46.content: Umzimba ubonisa apho ixesha livule livale khona, kodwa iintambo zibonisa uhambo lonke: lonke ixabiso umlo owafikelela kulo ngokwenene. Intambo ende ithetha ukuba kwabakho umlo omkhulu ngaphaya kokuvula nokuvala, kwaye icala elashiya intambo lalahlekelwa loo mlo. Intambo ende ezantsi? Abathengisi batyhala kakhulu baza babuyiselwa umva. Intambo ende phezulu? Abathengi bafikelela phezulu baza balelwa. Umzimba ngumxholo, iintambo zizo iindaba ezithethwayo. 📏

quiz.q: Ibonisa ntoni ngokwenene imigca emincinci (iintambo) engentla nangezantsi komzimba?
options: Elona xabiso liphezulu nelona lisezantsi elirhwetshiweyo ngelo xesha
Ukuvula nokuvala kwayizolo
Amaxabiso kanye apho iintengiselwano ezininzi zenzeka khona
Uqikelelo lomda wangomso

47.title: IDoji
47.content: Ngamanye amaxesha ikhandlela livula lize livale phantse kwixabiso elinye kanye, lishiye umzimba omncinci uneentambo macala omabini. Leyo yidoji, kwaye ithetha ukuba umtsalo wentambo waphela kungekho phumeleleyo: abathengi nabathengisi batsala kakhulu ixesha lonke kodwa akwabakho phumeleleyo. Ngokwayo ayithethi nto ingako. Emva kokubaleka okuqinileyo inokucebisa ukuba utyekelo luyadinwa, kuba icala ebeliphumelela lasilela ngequbuliso ukushukumisa ixabiso. Ngumkhondo ofanele uphawulwe, ungasoze ube sisiqinisekiso. 🤝

quiz.q: Ikhandlela elikhanyayo livule laza lavala phantse kwixabiso elinye kanye. Libizwa ntoni, kwaye licebisa ntoni?
options: Yimarubozu, umqondiso wokuqiniseka okupheleleyo kwelinye icala
Yihamile, umqondiso wokuba abathengi bathathe ulawulo
Ngumsantsa, umqondiso wokuba ukurhweba kumile ebusuku
Yidoji, umqondiso wokungagqibi phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi

48.title: IHamile
48.content: Yenza umfanekiso wexesha elimasikizi: abathengisi batyhalela ixabiso ezantsi, baze abathengi balibuyisele phezulu lonke phambi kokuvala. Into eseleyo kumzobo yihamile: umzimba omncinci ngasentla onentambo ende ngezantsi ephindwe ubuncinci kabini ubukhulu bawo. Emva kokutyibilika kusiya ezantsi, ihamile ithi abathengisi bazame olona nqindi lwabo lukhulu kodwa aluhlabanga. Oko kudla ngokuphawula utshintsho olunokwenzeka. Olunokwenzeka, kungekhona olwenzekayo ngokuqinisekileyo, ngoko ke yiphathe njengomkhondo omawuwujonge, kungekhona njengomyalelo wokuthenga. 🔨

quiz.q: Emva kokutyibilika kusiya ezantsi, ikhandlela elikhanyayo lishicilele intambo ende ngezantsi kunye nomzimba omncinci ngasentla. Iyintoni?
options: Yinkwenkwezi ewayo, umqondiso wokuba abathengisi bathathile
Yihamile, umkhondo wokuba abathengi balwe kakhulu bebuyisa
Yidoji, ukulingana okugqibeleleyo
Bubungqina bokuba utyekelo olwehlayo luphelile

49.title: INkwenkwezi Ewayo
49.content: Ngumfanekiso osesipilini wehamile. Emva kokunyuka okuqinileyo, abathengi bafikelela kwenye indawo entsha ephezulu, balelwe kabuhlungu, ize ixabiso livale libuyele ezantsi kufuphi nalapho livule khona. Umzobo ushicilela umzimba omncinci ngezantsi ekhandleleni onentambo ende ngentla: yinkwenkwezi ewayo. Ithetha ukuba abathengisi bafike ekugqibeleni phezulu benamandla aneleyo okuphumelela elo xesha. Emva kokubaleka okukhulu, oko kulelwa kudla ngokubaluleka. Kudla, kungekhona ngamaxesha onke. 🌠

quiz.q: Emva kokunyuka okuqinileyo, ikhandlela elikhanyayo litsibele phezulu laza lavala kufuphi nendawo yalo esezantsi, lishiya intambo ende ngentla. Iyintoni?
options: Yinkwenkwezi ewayo, umkhondo wokuba abathengisi bafike phezulu
Yihamile, umkhondo wokuba abathengi babuyele ekulawuleni
Yimarubozu eluhlaza, ngamandla okuthenga acocekileyo
Sisiqinisekiso sokuba ixabiso liya kuwa ngomso

50.title: IMarubozu
50.content: Imarubozu ngumzimba omnye oqinileyo ongenazo iintambo konke konke: ixabiso livule laza lahamba ngecala elinye ixesha lonke lingaze libheke umva. Akukho mlo, akukho kuthandabuza, kuqiniseka okupheleleyo kwicala elinye. Imarubozu eluhlaza ikhwaza ukuzithemba kwabathengi, ebomvu ikhwaza okuchaseneyo. Zinqabile, yiyo kanye loo nto abarhwebi bevuka bagalele xa kuvela enye. 💪

quiz.q: Ikhandlela elikhanyayo ngumzimba omnye oqinileyo ongenazo iintambo konke konke. Sikuxelela ntoni eso simo?
options: Akukho mntu owarhwebayo ngelo xesha, ngoko lahlala lithe tyaba
Imarike yavala kwangethuba ngaloo mini yalinqumla
Icala elinye lalilawula ukusuka ekuvuleni ukuya ekuvaleni, kuqiniseka okupheleleyo
Abathengi nabathengisi babelingana ncam ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni

51.title: Ukuginya Kwenkunzi
51.content: Amakhandlela amabini, umyalezo omnye. Kuqala ikhandlela elincinci elibomvu, into eqhelekileyo kutyekelo olwehlayo. Emva koko umzimba omkhulu oluhlaza oliginya lonke: kwixesha elinye, abathengi bacima yonke into abathengisi abayenzileyo ngemini yangaphambili, kwakunye nokungakumbi. Xa lifika emva kotyekelo olwehlayo, ukuginya kwenkunzi ngomnye wemikhondo yotshintsho ejongwa kakhulu kuwo nawuphi na umzobo, kuba lubonisa amandla etshintsha icala ngekhandlela elinye. Ngumkhondo, ayisosivumelwano. 🐂

quiz.q: Umzimba omkhulu oluhlaza uwuginya ngokupheleleyo umzimba obomvu ophambi kwawo. Yeyiphi le ndlela yamakhandlela amabini?
options: Kukuginya kwebhere, abathengisi bathathe ulawulo
Kukuginya kwenkunzi, abathengi boyise abathengisi
Sisiseko esiphindwe kabini
Zii-doji ezimbini ezilandelelanayo

52.title: Ukuginya Kwebhere
52.content: Ngumfanekiso osesipilini wowenkunzi. Encotsheni yokunyuka, umzimba omkhulu obomvu uginya wonke umzimba oluhlaza ophambi kwawo: abathengisi bacima ukuthenga kwemini engaphambili ngekhandlela elinye, kanye apho ukunyuka bekusele kolulekile nalapho abathengi bakutshanje bebexhalabile. Oko kudla ngokwenza nabanye abathengi baxhalabe. Xa uyibona emva kokubaleka okude, yihloniphe. 🐻

quiz.q: Encotsheni yokunyuka, umzimba omkhulu obomvu uginya wonke umzimba oluhlaza ophambi kwawo. Ibizwa ntoni le pere?
options: Kukuginya kwenkunzi, ukunyuka kuyaqhubeka
Yihamile ilandelwa yidoji
Kukuqhawuka kungentla komqobo
Kukuginya kwebhere, abathengisi boyise abathengi

53.title: Ukubona uTyekelo Olunyukayo
53.desc: Utyekelo: iincopho eziphakamayo, neendawo ezisezantsi eziphakamayo
53.content: Utyekelo olunyukayo lufuna zombini iinxalenye: iincopho eziphakamayo NEENDAWO ezisezantsi eziphakamayo. Incopho nganye ibetha eyangaphambili, kwaye ukwehla ngakunye kumisa phezulu kunokwangaphambili, kuba abathengi behlala bengena kwangoko qho. Olo milo lwezitepsi yimarike ikuxelela ukuba imfuno iyalawula. Incopho enye ephakamileyo yodwa ayingqini nto. Indlela yiloo pere, iphindaphindeka. 📈

quiz.q: Incopho nganye ibetha eyangaphambili, kwaye ukwehla ngakunye kumisa phezulu kunokwangaphambili. Ubonisa ntoni lo mzobo?
options: Lutyekelo olunyukayo, iincopho eziphakamayo neendawo ezisezantsi eziphakamayo
Lutyekelo olwehlayo, iincopho ezisezantsi neendawo ezisezantsi ezehla ngakumbi
Ngumda, ixabiso libambeke phakathi komgangatho nosilingi
Yincopho ephindwe kabini eqhubekayo

54.title: Ukubona uTyekelo Olwehlayo
54.desc: Utyekelo: iincopho ezisezantsi, neendawo ezisezantsi ezehlayo
54.content: Guqula izitepsi zibheke phantsi. Iincopho ezisezantsi zithetha ukuba abathengisi bahlasela kwangoko kudlobo ngalunye, iindawo ezisezantsi ezehla ngakumbi zithetha ukuba abathengi barhoxa ngakumbi ekwehleni ngakunye. Lo gama olo lwakhiwo lubambile, ngabathengisi abaqhuba umdlalo, kwaye ukulwa nabo yindlela abarhwebi abatsha abanikela ngayo ngemali kwabo banomonde. Utyekelo alusotshaba lwakho, kodwa ukwenza ngathi alukho ngokuqinisekileyo kulutshaba. 📉

quiz.q: Udlobo ngalunye luphelela ezantsi kunolwangaphambili, kwaye ukwehla ngakunye kusika nzulu ngakumbi. Ujonge ntoni?
options: Lutyekelo olunyukayo oluphefumlayo
Ngumda ohamba ecaleni
Lutyekelo olwehlayo, iincopho ezisezantsi neendawo ezisezantsi ezehla ngakumbi
Yindlela yokuginya kwenkunzi

55.title: Imarike Ehamba Ecaleni
55.content: Ngamanye amaxesha akukho cala liphumelelayo, ngoko ke ixabiso liyatsibatsiba nje phakathi komgangatho omnye nosilingi omnye iiveki ezininzi. Lowo ngumda, kwaye iimarike zichitha inxalenye enkulu yobomi bazo zisenza kanye oku. Ayonakalanga kwaye ayidiki, yimarike ephefumlayo. Abarhwebi abanomonde bafunda ukukuthanda ukulinda, kuba okukhona umda uhlala ixesha elide, kokukhona ukuphuma kwawo ekugqibeleni kudla ngokubaluleka ngakumbi. 🏓

quiz.q: Iiveki ngeeveki ixabiso lidlobe phakathi komgangatho omnye nosilingi omnye. Kubizwa ntoni oku?
options: Lutyekelo olunyukayo, lihlala lichukumisa usilingi
Ngumda, imarike ihamba ecaleni
Yintloko namagxa
Kukuqhawuka okuqhubekayo

56.title: Inkxaso
56.content: Xa ixabiso lihlala lisehla lisiya kwinqanaba elinye lize lidlobe qho, abarhwebi babiza elo nqanaba ngokuba yinkxaso: ngumgangatho apho abathengi behlala begqiba ukuba ixabiso litshiphu. Okukhona libambelela izihlandlo ezininzi, kokukhona abantu abaninzi belijonga, nto leyo eyinxalenye yesizathu sokuba lihlale libambelela. Kodwa khumbula ukuba umgangatho uzotywa ngabantu, kungekhona ngumthetho. Inkxaso ingaqhawuka kwaye iyaqhawuka, kwaye xa kusenzeka oko, isihlwele ebesilindele udlobo siba sisihlwele esingcangcazelayo. 🧱

quiz.q: Ixabiso lehlele kwinqanaba elimnyama izihlandlo ezithathu, laza ladloba ngesihlandlo ngasinye. Abarhwebi balibiza ntoni elo nqanaba?
options: Ngumqobo, usilingi apho abathengisi begcwala khona
Ngumgca wotyekelo, amanqanaba kufuneka athe tyaba
Sisimisi-lahleko esimiselwe liqonga
Yinkxaso, ngumgangatho apho abathengi behlala bengena khona

57.title: Umqobo
57.content: Umqobo ngusilingi: linqanaba apho ukunyuka ngakunye kuhlala kunqumama khona kuba abathengisi bevuya ukuthatha imali yabo apho. Bukela umzobo ubetha intloko yawo kwixabiso elinye izihlandlo ezithathu uze ubukele umqobo usebenza ngoku nangoku. Nantsi into efanele ikhunjulwe: ukuba ixabiso liyakhe liqhawule lidlule ngenkuthalo yokwenene, loo silingi umdala udla ngokuqala ukuziphatha njengomgangatho omtsha. 🪟

quiz.q: Ukunyuka okuthathu okwahlukeneyo kunqumame kwinqanaba elimnyama. Libizwa ntoni elo nqanaba?
options: Ngumqobo, usilingi apho abathengisi behlala betyhalela emva khona
Yinkxaso, ngumgangatho ohleli ngaphantsi kwexabiso
Linqanaba ledividendi, elimiselwa kanye ngonyaka
Kukudubula komthamo, okungathethi nto ngexabiso

58.title: Imigca yoTyekelo
58.content: Dibanisa iindawo ezisezantsi ezinyukayo kumzobo uze ube uzobe umgca wotyekelo. Naziphi na iindawo ezimbini zenza umgca, kodwa ukuchukumisa kwesithathu kulapho uqala ukungqina ukuba ubalulekile, kuba kubonisa ukuba abathengi bahlala belikhusela inqanaba elinye elinyukayo. Ukuchukumisa ngakunye okongezelelweyo okuhlonitshwayo bubungqina obungakumbi. Buhlala bubungqina, abusoze bube sisithembiso: umgca wotyekelo luphawu lwepensile, awungomnatha wamandla. ✏️

quiz.q: Lo mgca unyukayo uchukunyiswe izihlandlo ezithathu ezahlukeneyo. Kutheni abarhwebi bekhathala ukuba umgca wotyekelo uchukunyiswe kangaphi?
options: Abakhathali, kuba naziphi na iindawo ezimbini zenza umgca wotyekelo ube ngumthetho
Ukuchukumisa okuthathu kuthetha ukuba udlobo lwesine luqinisekisiwe olulandelayo
Ukuchukumisa okungakumbi kwenza umgca ubaluleke ngakumbi, abathengi bahlala bewukhusela
Imigca yotyekelo ibalulekile kwimizobo yemihla ngemihla kuphela, ingaze ibe kwemifutshane

59.title: Imijelo
59.content: Umjelo lutyekelo olunembeko. Ixabiso liyanyuka lidloba phakathi kwemigca emibini ehambelanayo: umgangatho weendawo ezisezantsi ezinyukayo nosilingi weencopho ezinyukayo, zihamba phezulu kunye njengamacala omendo. Abarhwebi bajonga onke amaphethelo befuna udlobo, kwaye bajonga ngakumbi usuku ixabiso eliphuma ngalo emendweni, kuba ukuqhawuka okucacileyo kumjelo kudla ngokuba yindawo apho ushukumo olukhulu olulandelayo luqala khona. 🛣️

quiz.q: Ixabiso liyanyuka lidloba phakathi kwemigca emibini ehambelanayo. Yeyiphi le ndlela?
options: Ngunxantathu, apho imigca emibini kufuneka idibane
Ngumjelo onyukayo, lutyekelo olunyukayo olunomendo obonakalayo
Yincopho ephindwe kabini
Ngumda othe tyaba ongayi ndawo kwaphela

60.title: INcopho Ephindwe Kabini
60.content: Ixabiso libetha usilingi omnye kabini, lisilela zombini izihlandlo, lize lizobe u-M omkhulu kumzobo. Qhawula ngezantsi kokwehla okuphakathi (umqala) size esi sincopho siphindwe kabini sigqitywe: ngumkhondo oqhelekileyo wotshintsho olwehlayo. Umfanekiso waso osesipilini, u-W, sisiseko esiphindwe kabini, kwaye sikhomba kwelinye icala. Sidla ngokuphawula incopho, kodwa akunyanzelekanga. Akukho nto ikumzobo enyanzelekileyo. Ⓜ️

quiz.q: Ixabiso libethe usilingi omnye kabini, lasilela zombini izihlandlo, laza laqhawula ngezantsi kokwehla okuphakathi. Yeyiphi le milo?
options: Sisiseko esiphindwe kabini, ngumkhondo wenkunzi
Ngumjelo onyukayo
Yihamile
Yincopho ephindwe kabini, ngumkhondo wotshintsho lwebhere

61.title: Xa Iindlela Zisilela
61.content: Esi sesona sifundo sixabisekileyo kweli candelo. Kwavela indlela efana ncam neyencwadi, wonke umntu wayibona, yaza imarike yenza okuchaseneyo. Zonke iindlela ozifundileyo ziyasilela ngamanye amaxesha, kwaye oko akungomzobo ukuxokisa, ngumzobo okunika ulwazi: icala obulixhasa lisandul' ukulahlekelwa. Gqiba ngendlela yakho yokuphuma phambi kokuba ungene, kwaye xa indlela isilela, thabatha umkhondo uphume. Iindlela ngamathuba, azisoze zibe zizithembiso. 🚪

quiz.q: Kwavela isiseko esiphindwe kabini sencwadi kumgangatho omnyama... laza ixabiso lawa lawuqhawula ngqo. Sithini isifundo esinyanisekileyo?
options: Iindlela ngamathuba, kungekhona izithembiso, kwaye indlela esilelayo ngumqondiso wakho wokuphuma
Iziseko eziphindwe kabini zokwenyani azisoze zisilele, ngoko lo ubuyijongile kufuneka ibingeyiyo eyokwenyani
Thenga ngakumbi kwixabiso eliphantsi, kuba indlela isaya kwenzeka ekugqibeleni
Imizobo iyayeka ukusebenza ngokupheleleyo xa indlela ikusilele ngolo hlobo

62.title: Intloko Namagxa
62.content: Iincopho ezintathu: ende phakathi (intloko), ephantsi macala omabini (amagxa), nomgca ophantsi kokwehla okubini obizwa ngokuba ngumqala. Yenzeka xa abathengi bekwazi ukutyhala okunye kokugqibela okuphezulu baze bangakwazi nokukulinganisa kwilinge elilandelayo. Umilo wodwa sisilumkiso kuphela. Into abarhwebi abayilindayo ngokwenene kukuqhawuka okugqibeleleyo ngezantsi komqala, kuba kulapho indlela iyeka khona ukuba ngumzobo iqale ukuba sisigqibo. 👤

quiz.q: Iincopho ezintathu: ende phakathi, ephantsi macala omabini, nomgangatho odibanisa ukwehla okubini. Yeyiphi le milo iqhelekileyo?
options: Sisiseko esiphindwe kathathu, iindawo ezisezantsi ezintathu ezilinganayo phambi kokutyhala phezulu
Yintloko namagxa, ukuphela okunokwenzeka kotyekelo olunyukayo
Ngunxantathu onyukayo
Ziihamile ezintathu ezilandelelanayo, nganye ikhaba amaxabiso asezantsi

63.title: Ukuxinana Konxantathu
63.content: Xa ukujikajika kuhlala kuncipha, iindawo ezisezantsi eziphakamayo zicinezela iincopho ezisezantsi, imarike isonga njengentsimbi. Lowo ngunxantathu: onke amacala aphelelwa yindawo, kunyanzelwa isigqibo. Ukuxinana kudla ngokuphela ngokuqhuma, kwaye nantsi into: icala lokuqhuma alaziwa kwangaphambili. Linda ukuqhawuka endaweni yokuqikelela. Imarike iza kukuxelela, kwaye ayibizi nto ngolo lwazi. 🌀

quiz.q: Ukujikajika kuhlala kuncipha, kuxina ixabiso kwisonga elixineneyo ngakumbi, de ekugqibeleni liqhume liphume. Ibiyintoni loo nto isongiweyo?
options: Ngumjelo, imigca emibini ehambelanayo engasoze idibane kwaphela
Yincopho ephindwe kabini
Ngunxantathu, kukudibana okudla ngokuphela ngokuqhawuka
Bubungqina bokuba ixabiso kwakufuneka linyuke ukusuka apha

64.title: Umthamo: Isifumanisi-buxoki
64.content: Umthamo zizabelo ezingaphi ezatshintsha izandla, kwaye sisifumanisi-buxoki semizobo. Ukuqhawuka ngomthamo omncinci sisisebezo esilahlekisa abantu: iintengiselwano ezimbalwa zatyhala ixabiso laya kwindawo elingenakuhlala kuyo. Ukuqhawuka ngomthamo omkhulu sisihlwele esivota ngokwenene ngemali. Ushukumo olunye lwexabiso, intsingiselo eyahluke ngokupheleleyo. Phambi kokuba ukholelwe naluphi na ushukumo olukhulu, jonga ukuba ngubani ofike kulo. 🔊

quiz.q: Amalinge amabini okuphuma kusilingi omnye: elokuqala ngomthamo omncinci lasilela, elesibini leza nomthamo omkhulu labambelela. Wenza ntoni umthamo apha?
options: Akukho nto konke konke, umthamo awuze ubaluleke kushukumo lwexabiso
Unyanzela ixabiso linyuke, kuba umthamo ophezulu utyhala amaxabiso phezulu
Uqikelela kanye incopho yoshukumo phambi kokuba yenzeke
Usebenza njengesiqinisekiso, umthamo omkhulu ubonisa ukuqiniseka kokwenene emva koshukumo

65.title: Isibonisi soTyekelo
65.desc: Imizobo elishumi, akukho malebhile, akukho nceba
65.content: Imizobo elishumi. Akukho malebhile, akukho migca yoncedo, akukho macebo. Chaza ukuba ngamnye ubonisa ntoni, kanye njengomrhwebi wokwenene ojonge kwiscreen sokwenyani. Fumana i-8 kwili-10 uze icandelo libe lelakho. Ufumana amalinge amathathu ngosuku, ngoko ke cotha, ufunde amakhandlela, uze ukhumbule esona sifundo sibaluleke ngaphezu kwazo zonke: ngamanye amaxesha impendulo enyanisekileyo kukuba akukho ndlela ikhoyo kwaphela. 🕯️
65.bossVictory: Icandelo lotyekelo loyisiwe. Ngoku uyayifunda imizobo, imizobo ayikufundi wena. 🕯️

options: Kukuginya kwenkunzi

6.q: Ixabiso liqhawule ladlula usilingi omdala, laza ukwehla okukhonjwa ngutolo kwabuyela kwelo nqanaba kwaza kwabambelela. Kwakuyintoni oko kwehla?
6.explanation: Ukwehla kwabuyela kanye kwinqanaba elalikade lingusilingi, kwafumana abathengi apho, lwaza utyekelo lwaqhubeka. Oko kukubuyela umva okuncinci. Utshintsho lwalusiya lusika ludlule kwinqanaba luze luqhubeke lusiwa.
options: Lutshintsho olupheleleyo olusiya kutyekelo olwehlayo

66.title: Apha Akukho Nto Uyiyo Eyakho
66.content:
Yonke into oyifundileyo kude kube ngoku ibinento ngasemva kwayo. Thenga isabelo sika-{retail} uze ube ngumnini wecandelo lenkampani: icandelo leevenkile, icandelo lenzuzo, ivoti kwintlanganiso, nedividendi xa behlawula.

I-derivative asiyiyo loo nto.

I-CFD (isivumelwano somahluko) sisivumelwano phakathi kwakho nomboneleli sokutshintshiselana ngomahluko wexabiso phakathi kokuvula nokuvala kwakho. Yiyo yonke loo mveliso. Ukuba u-{retail} uyanyuka kwaye ubhejile ukuba uyanyuka, bakuhlawula umahluko. Ukuba uyehla, wena ubahlawula bona. Akukho mntu uthenga isabelo. Akukho mntu uthengisa isabelo. Akukho zabelo zikhoyo naphi na kule ntengiselwano.

I-future sisivumelwano sokuthenga okanye ukuthengisa into ngexabiso elimiselweyo ngomhla omiselweyo. Ezokwenyani zihlawulwa ngeedrom zeoyile okanye ngeetoni zombona, kodwa phantse akakho ozibamba ixesha elide kangako, ngoko ke enyanisweni uninzi lwee-future zikwayibhethi kwinani elinomhla wokugqibela.

Kutheni oku kubaluleke ngaphezu kokuvakala kwako:

• Akukho zidividendi. Akukho Ntsana zeMali. Into eyakha inxalenye enkulu yembuyekezo kwisifundo 15 ayikho apha kwaphela.
• Akukho voti, akukho bunini, akukho nto yokubamba. Akukho khetho lokuthi "yibambe nje iminyaka elishumi", kuba akukho nto yokubamba.
• Akukho nzala idibeneyo. Yonke le app ichitha izifundo ezingama-65 ikufundisa ukuba ixesha likwicala lakho. Kule gumbi, ixesha likubiza imali. Uza kubona ukuba lingakanani kwisifundo 72.

Yonke into osele uyazi isabalulekile. Iyeka nje ukuba yiyo into oyenzayo. 📄

quiz.q: Uvula i-CFD ku-{retail} kwaye ixabiso liyanyuka. Yintoni ongumnini wayo ngokwenene?
quiz.explanation: I-CFD sisivumelwano phakathi kwakho nomboneleli sokutshintshiselana ngomahluko phakathi kwexabiso xa uvulayo nexabiso xa uvalayo. Akukho mntu uthenga isabelo, akukho mntu uthengisa nesinye, kwaye akukho nanye ekhoyo naphi na kwesi sivumelwano. Yiyo loo nto kungekho dividendi, kungekho voti kwaye kungekho nto yokubamba iminyaka elishumi.
options: Izabelo umboneleli azibambe egameni lakhe
Isivumelwano sokutshintshiselana ngomahluko wexabiso ekugqibeleni
Inxalenye yenkampani, needividendi ezilandelayo
Ivawutsha eguquka ibe zizabelo zokwenene xa uvala

67.title: Ukuboleka Kumhlobo
67.desc: Iyintoni i-leverage ngokwenene, nenxalenye engaposwa mntu
67.content:
I-leverage ivakala inobuchule. Ayinjalo. Kukuboleka.

Masithi ufuna izabelo ze-{c}1,000 kodwa une-{c}200 kuphela. Umhlobo uzinikela ukufaka enye i-{c}800. Ulawula izabelo ze-{c}1,000 nge-{c}200 yemali yakho. Yiyo leyo i-leverage. Yiyo yonke le ngcinga.

Ngoku zintathu izinto azenzayo loo mhlobo. Uzifuna zontathu, okanye uthengiselwe intsomi.

1️⃣ INZUZO IYEYAKHO NGOKWENENE. Izabelo zinyuka nge-10%. I-{c}1,000 yakho ngoku yi-{c}1,100. Leyo yi-{c}100 yenzuzo kwaye ugcina yonke isenti yayo, kuba umhlobo wakho utyalwa i-{c}800 kuphela hayi ne{cName} ngaphezulu. Kwi-{c}200 yakho, i-{c}100 yinzuzo eyi-50%. Ushukumo lwe-10% lukwenzele i-50%. Yile nxalenye wonke umntu ayiposayo.

2️⃣ ITYALA ALINCIPHI XA UNGACHANANGA. Le yinxalenye engaposwa mntu, kwaye sisifundo siphela. Izabelo zehla nge-10% endaweni yoko. I-{c}1,000 yakho ngoku yi-{c}900. Usalityala umhlobo wakho i-{c}800 ipheleleyo. Hayi i-{c}720. I-{c}800 ipheleleyo. Ngoko ke yonke i-{c}100 yokwehla iphuma KWISABELO SAKHO, kwaye i-{c}200 yakho ngoku yi-{c}100. Ushukumo lwe-10% lukubize i-50%.

Zifunde kwakhona ezo zimbini. Umhlobo omnye, i-10% enye. Imali yakho ihamba ngesantya esiphindwe kahlanu kumacala omabini, kuba ityala alize lithathe isabelo sentlungu.

3️⃣ UMHLOBO UBIZA IRENTE, MIHLA LE, KUYO YONKE INTO. Kungekhona kwi-{c}800 yakhe. Kwi-{c}1,000 epheleleyo oyilawulayo. Bonke ubusuku oyibambileyo, nokuba ixabiso linyukile, lehlile, okanye lingayanga ndawo.

Kwaye kukho into yesine ifihlakele ngaphakathi kweyesithathu. Ukuba i-{c}200 yakho iyaphela, umhlobo wakho akakufowuneli ukuze nithethe ngayo. Uyathengisa. Ngoko nangoko, ngokuzenzekelayo, nangaliphi na ixabiso elifumanekayo, kuba yi-{c}800 yakhe esemngciphekweni kwaye akalulindanga uluvo lwakho. Loo nto inegama, kwaye uza kudibana nayo kwizifundo ezintathu ezizayo: i-liquidation.

Ngoko ke: inzuzo enkulu ngakumbi, iilahleko ezinkulu ngakumbi, irente bonke ubusuku, nomnye umntu onomnwe kwiqhosha lokuthengisa. I-leverage ayisiyomali yasimahla enomngcipheko omncinci. Lityala elinazo zone ezo zinto, kwaye iintengiso zikubonisa eyokuqala kuphela. 🧠

quiz.q: Umhlobo ufaka i-800 NT, wena ufaka i-200 NT, kwaye kunye nilawula izabelo ze-1,000 NT. Izabelo zehla nge-10%. Tsala uye kwixabiso le-200 NT yakho ngoku.
quiz.explanation: Ityala alincipheli xa ungachananga. Izabelo ngoku zixabisa i-900 NT kwaye umhlobo wakho usatyalwa i-800 NT ipheleleyo, ngoko i-100 NT yiyo eseleyo kuwe. Ukwehla kwe-10% kwizabelo kuthathe isiqingatha semali yakho, kuba ityala alithathi nanye intlungu. Kusebenza ngendlela efanayo xa kunyuka, kwaye yileyo isiqingatha esiboniswa ziintengiso.

68.title: I-Margin Yidiphozithi, Ayisiyontengo
68.content:
Xa uthenga isabelo nge-{c}100, loo {c}100 ihambile kwimali yakho size isabelo sihlale kwiakhawunti yakho. Kukutshintshiselana okulula.

I-margin ayisebenzi ngaloo ndlela. Xa uvula isikhundla se-leverage ubeka idiphozithi, kwaye loo diphozithi ayisiyontlawulo yanto. Yidiphozithi yokhuseleko echasene neelahleko zakho. Ihlala apho, itshixiwe, kwaye isikhundla siyayitya njengoko ixabiso lishukuma lichasene nawe.

Masithi izinga lediphozithi yi-25%. Ubeka i-250 NT uze ulawule i-1,000 NT yobungozi. Jonga iakhawunti yakho:

• Ixabiso lithe cwaka: i-250 yakho isengu-250. Kodwa imali yenkxaso-mali sele iqalile, ngoko incinci ngokuzolileyo.
• Ixabiso lehle nge-5%: isikhundla silahlekelwe yi-50 NT. Idiphozithi yakho ngokusebenzayo ngu-200. Imali yakho ekhululekileyo ayishukumanga. Iakhawunti yakho incinci.
• Ixabiso lehle nge-20%: isikhundla silahlekelwe yi-200 NT. Idiphozithi yakho yehle yaya kwi-50. Awenzanga nto. Akuthengisanga nto. Ubukele.

Mathathu amagama ahlala kuzo zonke iiscreen kule gumbi:

🔒 I-MARGIN ESETYENZISIWEYO: yonke idiphozithi onayo ebekiweyo ngoku.
💰 I-EQUITY YEAKHAWUNTI: imali yakho ekhululekileyo, kunye ne-margin yakho ebekiweyo, kunye nenzuzo nelahleko yaso sonke isikhundla esivulekileyo, kususwe imali yenkxaso-mali ebizwe kude kube ngoku. Yinto iakhawunti yakho eyixabisayo ngokwenene ukuba yonke into ivalwa ngoku.
📊 INQANABA LE-MARGIN: i-equity yahlulwe nge-margin esetyenzisiweyo. Ngaphezu kwe-100% unomqamelo. Ngaphantsi kwe-100% imarike sele iwugqibile umqamelo yaza yaqala kwidiphozithi.

Kwaye nomthetho omnye omangalisa wonke umntu: i-margin ilinganiswa kuyo yonke iakhawunti yakho, kungekhona kwisikhundla ngasinye. Isikhundla esilahlekelwayo sitya isibambiso esixhasa esiphumelelayo. Yiyo loo nto ukuthi "enye intengiselwano yam ilungile" kungengokuzikhusela. 🔒

quiz.q: Izinga lediphozithi yi-25%, ngoko i-250 NT yemali yakho ilawula i-1,000 NT yobungozi. Ixabiso lehla nge-8% ngelixa ungenzi nto konke konke. Tsala uye kwisixa esikubize sona olo kwehla.
quiz.explanation: Idiphozithi ayisiyontlawulo yanto, sisibambiso, kwaye ilahleko ibalwa kuyo yonke i-1,000 NT oyilawulayo. I-8% ye-1,000 NT yi-80 NT. Awuthengisanga nto kwaye imali yakho ekhululekileyo ayishukumanga, kodwa i-80 NT yediphozithi yakho ye-250 NT sele ityiwe kwaye iakhawunti yakho incinci nge-80 NT. Ukuba ubala i-8% kwidiphozithi endaweni yoko ufumana i-20 NT, kwaye le yimpazamo eyenza i-leverage ibonakale ingenabungozi.

69.title: I-Margin Call
69.content:
I-margin call ngumzuzu apho inqanaba lakho le-margin lehla ngaphantsi kwe-100%. Ngamagama acacileyo: umqamelo wakho wenzuzo uphelile kwaye imarike sele iqale ukutya idiphozithi ngokwayo.

Nantsi indlela evakala ngayo ngokwenene, kuba inguqulelo yencwadi ishiya inxalenye ebalulekileyo.

Ayifiki ngosuku olulungileyo. Ifika xa isikhundla sele simbi, xa sele uzixelele kabini ukuba iza kubuya, naxa ungakwazi kwaphela ukwenza isigqibo esizolileyo. Asisosilumkiso esinesidima. Sisibizo esinyanzelayo: faka imali engakumbi, okanye uvale izikhundla, okanye umboneleli akwenzele oko.

Unamanyathelo amathathu kwaye mabini kuphela kuwo angawakho.

1️⃣ VALA into. Oku kukhulula i-margin ngoko nangoko kwaye phantse ihlala iyimpendulo elungileyo. Kukwathetha ukuvuma ukuba ubungachananga, esisona sizathu sokuba abantu bangakwenzi.
2️⃣ YONGEZA imali. Oku akulungisi nto. Kukuthengela indawo yokuba ungachani ixesha elide, kwisikhundla obusele usikhethe kakubi, ngemali obungacwangcisanga ukuyibeka emngciphekweni. Ukongeza imali kwi-margin call yindlela intengiselwano embi eba yinyanga embi ngayo.
3️⃣ UNGENZI NTO. Emva koko inyathelo lesithathu lenzeka ngaphandle kwakho, kwaye linegama.

Abalawuli bakuthatha oku ngokungqongqo kangangokuba babhala inani emthethweni. Iinkampani eYurophu, e-UK nase-Australia kufuneka zivale ngokuzenzekelayo izikhundla zomthengi xa i-margin yakhe isihla ifika kwi-50% yaleyo bekufuneka ibekhona. Kungekhona "kufanele". KUFUNEKA. Bawubhala loo mthetho kuba xa abantu beshiywa bezigqibela ngokwabo, bakhetha ukhetho lwesithathu baza balahlekelwa ngaphezu kwaleyo bebenayo. ⚠️

quiz.q: Inqanaba lakho le-margin lehle laya kwi-80% kwaye ukwi-margin call. Yeyiphi impendulo enciphisa ngokwenene umngcipheko we-liquidation endaweni yokuwulibazisa nje?
quiz.explanation: Ukuvala kubuyisela idiphozithi kwangoko, ngoko inqanaba le-margin lixhuma ngoko nangoko. Ukongeza imali kuthenga nje indawo yokuba ungachani ixesha elide kwintengiselwano obusele uyikhethe kakubi. Ukulinda yindlela i-liquidation eyenzeka ngayo. Kwaye isikhundla sesibini kwelinye icala sifuna idiphozithi yaso, ngoko sisebenzisa i-margin engakumbi, hayi encinci.
options: Ukufaka imali engakumbi kwiakhawunti
Ukulinda ukuba inqanaba le-margin liphinde linyuke
Ukuvala esinye sezikhundla ezivulekileyo onazo
Ukuvula isikhundla sesibini kwelinye icala

70.title: I-Liquidation, Nexabiso Omele Ulazi Kuqala
70.desc: Ixabiso kanye apho iakhawunti yakho ifika kwiqanda
70.content:
I-liquidation kukuvala komboneleli izikhundla zakho egameni lakho kuba idiphozithi yakho iphantse yaphela. Kuzenzekela ngokwako. Kwenzeka ngoko nangoko. Akakho ubuza uluvo lwakho, akakho ojonga ukuba ubusele uza kuchana kusini na, kwaye akukho sibheno.

Elona nani liluncedo kweli candelo liphela LIXABISO LAKHO LE-LIQUIDATION: ixabiso lokwenene, ngemali ephathekayo ({cPlural}), apho oko kwenzeka khona.

Kungekhona ipesenti. Lixabiso. Kuba ukuthi "unokulahlekelwa yidiphozithi yakho" sisivakalisi onokusinqwala uze usilibale, ngelixa ukuthi "u-{tech} kwi-{c}87.40 kwaye iakhawunti yakho ize" liyinyaniso onokuyijonga kumzobo phambi kokuba ucofe nantoni na.

Zonke iiscreen kule gumbi ziyalibonisa phambi kokuba uqinisekise, lizotywe kwisikali sexabiso esifanayo nesomzobo ukuze ubone ukuba likude kangakanani ngokwenene. Zimbini izinto oza kuziqaphela ngoko nangoko, kwaye zombini zisisifundo:

📏 Idiphozithi enkulu ityhalela ixabiso le-liquidation kude ngakumbi. Imali yakho engakumbi ithetha ukuba ixabiso limele lihle kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba imali yakho iphele.
⚡ Idiphozithi encinci ilitsalela kufuphi nexabiso lanamhlanje. Ngediphozithi ye-10%, i-liquidation imalunga noshukumo lwe-10% ukusuka apho, kwaye ushukumo lwe-10% yiveki eqhelekileyo.

Emva koko nantsi inyaniso ebuhlungu. Ixabiso le-liquidation lilapho injini ijonge ukukuvala khona, kungekhona apho uqinisekiswa ukuba uza kuphuma khona. Ukuba kufika iindaba ezimbi ebusuku ize imarike ivule kude ngaphantsi kwelo nqanaba, uvalwa nangayiphi na imali imarike eza kuyihlawula ngokwenene. Nguloo msantsa, kwaye isifundo 78 sithetha ngawo.

Yazi ixabiso lakho le-liquidation phambi kokuba uvule. Ukuba awukwazi ukulithetha ngokuvakalayo, awuyiqondi intengiselwano oza kuyenza. 💀

quiz.q: Ubeka i-200 NT njengediphozithi ukuze ulawule i-1,000 NT yeasethi exabisa i-100 NT. Tsala ixabiso liye ezantsi apho idiphozithi yakho iphela khona.
quiz.explanation: Ulawula iiyunithi ezili-10, ngoko yonke i-1 NT ewiswa lixabiso ikubiza i-10 NT. Idiphozithi yakho ye-200 NT iphela kwi-80 NT, okukwehla kwe-20% kuphela.

71.title: Indlela Yokubuya Inzima Ngakumbi
71.desc: Kutheni iilahleko kunzima ukuzibuyisa kunokuba zibonakala
71.content:
Iilahleko nenzuzo zivakala ngathi ziyachasana. Azichasani, kwaye imathematika ayikufuphi.

Ulahlekelwe yi-10%? Ufuna i+11% ukuze ubuye. Kuyacaphukisa, kulungile.
Ulahlekelwe yi-50%? Ufuna i+100%. Kufuneka UPHINDE KABINI ukuze nje ulingane.
Ulahlekelwe yi-75%? Ufuna i+300%.
Ulahlekelwe yi-90%? Ufuna i+900%.

Isizathu silula xa sele usibona: inzuzo ibalwa kwimfumba encinci osele ushiyeke nayo. I-100 iwela kwi-50, kwaye ukuze ukhwele usuka kwi-50 ubuyele kwi-100 loo mfumba incinci kufuneka iphinde kabini.

Ngoku yongeza i-leverage, uze uqaphele ukuba yenza ntoni ngokwenene. Ayenzi nje inzuzo yakho ikhawuleze. Ikushukumisela ezantsi kuloo tafile ngemva kwemini enye. Ukwehla kwe-12% kwisabelo, okuyiveki embi kodwa eqhelekileyo, kukubetha kwe-48% kwiakhawunti yakho ngediphozithi ye-25%. Ngoku ufuna i+92% ukuze ubuyele apho ubuqale khona, ngenxa yeveki ebingafikanga nasezindabeni.

Yiyo le nto oochwepheshe bethetha ngokukhusela imali-nkunzi phambi kokuba bathethe nangantoni na enye, nokuba kutheni ukuthi "ndiza kuyibuyisa" sisivakalisi esibiza kakhulu kurhwebo. Ukuyibuyisa kunzima ngokwamanani kunokuyilahla, ngalo lonke ixesha. ⛰️

quiz.q: Iakhawunti yakho yehle nge-75%. Tsala uye kwinzuzo oyifunayo ukusuka apha ukuze nje ubuyele apho ubuqale khona.
quiz.explanation: I-100 NT yehla yaya kwi-25 NT. Ukuze ifike kwi-100 kwakhona loo 25 kufuneka iphindwe kane, okuyinzuzo ye-300%. Ukunyuka kulinganiswa kwimfumba encinci osele ushiyeke nayo, yiyo loo nto kunzima kangaka kunokwehla.

72.title: Irente Yemali Ebolekiweyo
72.content:
Ububolekile ubungozi. Ngoko uyabuhlawulela. Bonke ubusuku.

Imali yenkxaso-mali (ezinye iindawo ziyibiza ngokuba yi-swap, okanye intlawulo yasebusuku) ibizwa mihla le, kwaye nantsi inxalenye ebamba wonke umntu: ibizwa kwisikhundla ESIPHELELEYO, kungekhona kwinxalenye oyibolekileyo. Beka i-500 NT ukuze ulawule i-2,000 NT kwaye uhlawula irente kwi-2,000.

Indlela ebalwa ngayo: izinga lenzala elisisalathiso, kunye nenzuzo eyongezwa ngumboneleli, yahlulwe ngama-365, iphindwe ngesikhundla sakho esipheleleyo. Ubona zombini iinxalenye kwiscreen kule app, kuba intlawulo ongakwaziyo ukuyiqhekeza yintlawulo ongakwaziyo ukuyigweba. Malunga ne-7.3% ngonyaka, oko kumalunga ne-0.02% yesikhundla sakho ngobusuku.

Kuvakala ngathi akuyonto. Ngoku jonga isitya intengiselwano ephumelelayo. 🧾

INTENGISELWANO OYICHANAYO KODWA USALAHLEKELWA

Uvula isikhundla se-2,000 NT ku-{retail} ngediphozithi ye-500 NT. Ukholelwa ukuba liza kunyuka, kwaye ekugqibeleni uyachana: kwiinyanga ezimbalwa ezizayo u-{retail} unyuka kancinci nge-2%.

• Inzuzo yakho: i-2% ye-2,000 = 40 NT. Kwidiphozithi ye-500 NT oko yi-+8%. Kuhle.
• Irente yakho: i-0.02% ye-2,000 = 0.40 NT, bonke ubusuku.

Ubusuku 50: uhlawule i-20 NT. Uphezulu nge-20 NT xa iyonke. Usaphumelela.
Ubusuku 100: uhlawule i-40 NT. I-40 NT yakho yenzuzo ngoku ixabisa iqanda kanye. Uchanile kodwa akwenzanga nto.
Ubusuku 180: uhlawule i-72 NT. Inzuzo yakho isengu-40 NT. UPHANTSI nge-32 NT, okuyilahleko ye-6.4% yediphozithi yakho, kwintengiselwano apho uyifunde ngokuchanekileyo imarike iinyanga ezintandathu.

Phinda ukufunde oko. Ixabiso lenze kanye oko ubutshilo. Kodwa usalahlekelwe.

Sesi isivakalisi omele usithathe kwesi sifundo: kwisikhundla se-leverage, ukuchana kunomhla wokuphelelwa. Kulo mzekelo bubusuku obu-100 ukusuka ngoku, kwaye ungawubala owakho phambi kokuba uvule. Yahlula inzuzo oyithembileyo ngerente yasebusuku. Lelo linani lobusuku uluvo lwakho oluxabisa bona.

Okuchaseneyo nako kufanele ukuqatshelwa. Yonke le app ifundisa inzala edibeneyo, apho ixesha likwenzela imali ngokuzolileyo ngelixa ulele. Lo ngumatshini ofanayo, usebenza ngasemva, ujolise kuwe. ⏳

quiz.q: Ubambe isikhundla se-leverage se-2,000 NT esikubiza i-0.40 NT ngobusuku kwimali yenkxaso-mali. Ixabiso linyuka ngokwaneleyo ukuba likunike inzuzo ye-40 NT, emva koko liyeka ukushukuma. Emva kobusuku obungaphi loo nzuzo ityiwe yonke?
options: Ayize ityiwe, kuba imali yenkxaso-mali ibizwa kuphela kwinxalenye ebolekiweyo
Malunga nobusuku obu-100, kuba i-40 NT yenzuzo yahlulwe nge-0.40 NT ngobusuku yi-100
Malunga nobusuku obu-20, kuba imali yenkxaso-mali ibizwa kwidiphozithi yakho ye-500 NT
Imali yenkxaso-mali ibizwa kuphela xa isikhundla sivalwa ngelahleko

73.title: Ii-Future: Iwotshi Nokuqengqeleka
73.content:
Ii-future nee-CFD zingabazala. Zombini zine-leverage, zombini zisebenzisa i-margin, zombini zinokukuvala nge-liquidation. Zimbini izinto ezenza ii-future zahluke, kwaye eyesibini yeyona inomdla.

⏰ 1. KUKHO UMHLA KUYO. Sonke isivumelwano se-future siyaphelelwa. Ioyile kaMatshi, umbona kaJuni, isalathiso sikaSeptemba. Xa umhla ufika isivumelwano siyahlawulwa size siyeke ukubakho. "Yibambe ulinde ibuye" ayikho nje kwimenyu, kuba isivumelwano asizukubakho. I-CFD ayize iphelelwe, nto leyo evakala ingcono de ukhumbule ukuba ibiza irente ngonaphakade.

🔄 2. IINDLEKO ZAKHIWE NGAPHAKATHI KWEXABISO, AZIBIZWA NGOBUSUKU. Le yinxalenye abantu abayiphosayo. I-future ayiqhelanga ukukubiza intlawulo yasebusuku yenkxaso-mali. Endaweni yoko, iindleko zokubamba loo nto de kufike loo mhla sele zibhakiwe kwixabiso lesivumelwano. Izivumelwano zemihla yamva zihlala zibiza ngaphezu kwezivumelwano zemihla ekufuphi, kwaye loo msantsa ziindleko ezifanayo zokubamba, zihleli ngaphakathi kwinani.

Ngoko kwenzeka ntoni xa umrhwebi efuna ukugcina isikhundla emva kokuphelelwa? BAYAQENGQELEKA (ROLL): bavale isivumelwano esiphelelwayo, bavule esilandelayo. Kwaye ukuba esilandelayo sibiza ngakumbi, bahlawula loo mahluko. Kuko konke ukuqengqeleka. Leyo yirente yasebusuku ye-CFD, eqokelelwa ngezavenge ezinkulu ezingaqhelekanga kangako.

Isishwankathelo esinyanisekileyo:

• CFD: akukho mhla wokugqibela, irente bonke ubusuku, idweliswe kwingxelo yakho.
• Future: umhla wokugqibela oqinileyo, iindleko zifihlwe ngaphakathi kwexabiso zize zihlawulwe kuko konke ukuqengqeleka, kulula ukuziphosa.

Akukho nanye esimahla. Enye nje ibonisa ityala ngembeko ngakumbi, kwaye iindleko ongaziboniyo zezona zinokukothusa. ⏳

74.title: Ukuya Kwi-Short: Ilahleko Engenamda
74.desc: Kutheni ukubheja ukuba liza kwehla kungenamda wendalo phezulu
74.content:
Yonke into kule app kude kube ngoku ibiyi-long: uyathenga, ufuna ixabiso linyuke. Ii-derivative zikuvumela ukuba uye kwi-short, okuthetha ukubheja ukuba ixabiso liza kwehla. Uvula i-short, ixabiso liyehla, uyazuza.

Ukuya kwi-short kuluncedo ngokwenene kwaye akukho bubi. Yindlela umfama atshixa ngayo ixabiso phambi kokuvuna nendlela ingxowa-mali ekhusela ngayo iphothifoliyo. Ukukuqonda kukwenza ube ngcono ekufundeni iimarike, kuba okokuqala unokubona omabini amacala ayo yonke intengiselwano.

Kodwa kukho iqhekeza elinye lemathematika kwi-short elingenamlingane naphi na kwenye indawo, kwaye kufuneka ulitshise engqondweni.

📉 XA UTHENGA, eyona meko imbi kukuba ixabiso liye kwiqanda. Ulahlekelwa yi-100% yento oyifakileyo. Kubi kakhulu, kodwa ngumgangatho. Kukho ezantsi.
📈 XA UYA KWI-SHORT, ixabiso elichasene nawe lithetha ixabiso ELINYUKAYO. Kwaye akukho mthetho naphi na othi ixabiso livumelekile ukuya phezulu kangakanani. Isabelo esiphindwe kathathu sikubiza i-200% yesikhundla. Isabelo esinyuka kalishumi sikubiza i-900%.

Iilahleko ze-long zinomgangatho. Iilahleko ze-short azinawo. Olo kungalingani sisilumkiso siphela.

Iimarike zokwenyani ziyakwenza oku. Ngamaxesha athile isabelo esinee-short ezininzi siyaqhuma, kuba wonke umntu okwi-short unyanzelekile ukuthenga ukuze avale, nto leyo etyhala ixabiso phezulu ngakumbi, nto leyo inyanzela abaninzi ngakumbi ukuba bathenge. Oku kubizwa ngokuba yi-short squeeze kwaye sele kuphelise iingxowa-mali.

Zimbini izinto ezikugcina uphila. Okokuqala, i-short yindawo kanye apho i-stop-loss iyeka ukuba lukhetho. Okwesibini, ukhuseleko lwebhalansi engalunganga: kwiakhawunti elawulwa ngokufanelekileyo yomthengi oqhelekileyo, nakule app, iakhawunti yakho ayinakuya ngaphantsi kweqanda. Ungalahlekelwa yiyo yonke into oyifakileyo. Awunakugqibela unetyala lemali. Olo khuseleko lukhona kuba, phambi kwalo, abantu babesiba namatyala. 🕳️

Kwi-short kuchaseneyo, kuba ukulahlekelwa kuthetha ukuba ixabiso liyanyuka, kwaye akukho nto ithi ixabiso lingaya phezulu kangakanani. 75.title: Ukungazinzi Kuphindwe nge-Leverage
75.desc: Kutheni i-crypto ifuna eyona diphozithi inkulu apha
75.content:
Isiphindaphindi esifanayo kwiiasethi ezimbini ezahlukeneyo asikokubheja okufanayo. Yiyo yonke ingcinga kwesi sifundo, kwaye yiyo le nto idiphozithi omele uyibeke itshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwinto oyirhwebayo.

Cinga ngendlela usuku oluqhelekileyo olujongeka ngayo:
• Isalathiso esikhulu sishukuma ngaphantsi kwe-1% ngeentsuku ezininzi.
• Isabelo esinye sinokushukuma nge-2% okanye nge-3%.
• I-crypto ihlala ishukuma nge-5% okanye nge-10%, kwaye usuku lwe-20% asiyongxaki enkulu, nguLwesibini nje. 🎢

Ngoku beka idiphozithi encinci ngasemva kwezo nganye. Ngediphozithi ye-10%, ushukumo lwe-10% luyakutshayela. Kwisalathiso, leyo yinto eyenzeka kanye kwiminyaka eliqela. Kwi-crypto imalunga nokwenzeka nyanga nganye. Idiphozithi efanayo. Amathuba okusinda ahluke ngokupheleleyo.

Abalawuli bakuqonda oku baza bakubhala kwimithetho. Xa i-ESMA yabeka umda kwi-leverage ye-CFD kulo lonke elaseYurophu ngoMatshi 2018, ayizange ikhethe inani elinye. Yawahlela ngamanqanaba: 30:1 kwizibini zemali eziphambili, 20:1 kwigolide nakwizalathiso eziphambili, 10:1 kwezinye iimveliso zorhwebo, 5:1 kwizabelo ngazinye, kwaye ezantsi kanye, 2:1 kwi-crypto. Isibini kwisinye sithetha idiphozithi ye-50%. Kwi-crypto bafuna ISIQINGATHA sesikhundla ngemali yokwenyani, elona zinga lingqongqo kuluhlu lonke.

Le app yenza into efanayo, ngesizathu esifanayo, kwaye ikutsho kwiscreen endaweni yokukufihla:

💱 Forex: eyona diphozithi incinci, kuba izibini eziphambili zezona zishukuma kancinci.
🥇 Igolide neemveliso zorhwebo: enkulu ngakumbi.
📊 Izabelo, izalathiso nee-ETF: enkulu ngakumbi kwakhona.
🪙 Crypto: eyona diphozithi inkulu kuzo zonke, kuba i-crypto yeyona ishukuma kakhulu.

I-crypto ayivalwanga apha, kwaye oko kwenziwe ngabom. Ungayirhweba. Nje awunakuyirhweba ngediphozithi encinci, kuba ngediphozithi encinci usuku oluqhelekileyo lwe-crypto lungaphelisa iakhawunti yakho ngaphambi kokuba ugqibe ukufunda ngayo. Idiphozithi enkulu ayisiyo-app ingqongqo nje nge-crypto. Yi-app eqinisekisa ukuba usuku oluqhelekileyo alunakukubulala.

Kufanelekile ukwazi: umlawuli wase-UK waya kude ngaphezu kwenqanaba. Ngo-2021 wavala ngokupheleleyo ii-derivative ze-crypto kubathengi abaqhelekileyo, eqikelela ukuba abathengi baza konga malunga ne-£53m. Ungadibana ne-leverage ye-crypto apha, ngemali yokuzenzisa nediphozithi etyebileyo, okanye ungadibana nayo uneminyaka elishumi elinesibhozo ngemali yokwenyani kungekho silumkiso kwaphela. Olu lulandelelwano olungcono. 🌡️

76.title: Amanani Angabhengezwa Mntu
76.content:
Awusoze uwabone la manani kwintengiso. Avela kubalawuli bezemali, abanokufuna eyona datha yeeakhawunti kwiinkampani, baze bapapashe oko bakufumeneyo.

🇪🇺 I-ESMA, umlawuli waseYurophu, ngoMatshi 2018. Kumazwe e-EU, phakathi kwe-74% ne-89% yeeakhawunti ze-CFD zabathengi abaqhelekileyo ziyalahlekelwa yimali. Iilahleko eziqhelekileyo kumthengi ngamnye zazisuka kwi-€1,600 ukuya kwi-€29,000. I-ESMA yawuthintela lo mveliso ngenxa yoko.

🇬🇧 I-FCA e-UK, ngoDisemba 2016. Uhlalutyo lwayo lwesampulu emele iiakhawunti zabathengi lwafumanisa ukuba i-82% yabathengi ilahlekelwe yimali kwezi mveliso.

🇦🇺 I-ASIC e-Australia, yapapashwa ngoJanuwari 2026, eyona intsha kwezi zintathu. Kunyaka-mali ka-2024, i-68% yabatyali-mali be-CFD abaqhelekileyo balahlekelwa yimali, iyonke ingaphezulu kwe-A$458 million. Kuloo mali, i-A$73 million yayiziintlawulo.

Hlala nalo mgca wokugqibela umzuzwana. Izigidi ezingamashumi asixhenxe anesithathu zayo zazingezizo nezorhwebo olubi. Yayiziindleko zokudlala: i-spread xa ungena, nemali yenkxaso-mali odibene nayo kwisifundo 72.

Abalawuli abathathu abahlukeneyo, amazwe amathathu ahlukeneyo, idatha egubungela amashumi eminyaka amathathu ahlukeneyo, kwaye impendulo isoloko iwela kwindawo ethile phakathi kwesibini kwisithathu nesithoba kwishumi.

Ngoku inxalenye ebaluleke kakhulu, kuba yiyo emisa oku ukuba kube linani loyikisayo nje. Abo bantu babengezozidenge. Babengengobavila. Uninzi lwabo yayingabantu abadala abasebenzayo, kwaye abaninzi babo babefunda itshathi ngcono kunawe okwangoku. Balahlekelwa ngenxa yendlela umveliso owakhiwe ngayo: uqala usemva nge-spread, uhlawula irente ngelixa ulindile, kwaye i-leverage ithetha ukuba ushukumo oluqhelekileyo lungakuphelisa phambi kokuba uluvo lwakho lufumane ixesha lokuchana.

77.title: Yintoni Eyatshintshayo Xa Imithetho Itshintsha
77.content:
Isifundo 76 sikunike iilahleko. Esi sifundo sikunika uvavanyo, kwaye yeyona nto ibalulekileyo kweli candelo.

Ukuba uninzi lwabantu lulahlekelwa kuba uninzi lwabantu lungakhathali, ngoko ukutshintsha imithetho akufanele kutshintshe nto. Abangakhathaliyo bahlala bengakhathali. Akunjalo?

I-Australia yenza uvavanyo. NgoMatshi 2021 i-ASIC yanyanzela iseti yokhuseleko kuzo zonke iinkampani ze-CFD ezisebenzela abathengi abaqhelekileyo: imida ye-leverage, umthetho oqhelekileyo wokuvala ngokuzenzekelayo, ukhuseleko lwebhalansi engalunganga, nokuvalwa kwezihendo ezifana neebhonasi zokubhalisa. Abathengi abafanayo. Iinkampani ezifanayo. Iimarike ezifanayo. Kwatshintsha imithetho kuphela.

Nantsi into eyalinganiswa yi-ASIC kwiinyanga ezintandathu zokuqala. 🔬

📉 Iilahleko ezipheleleyo ezicocekileyo zeeakhawunti zabathengi abaqhelekileyo zehla nge-91%, ukusuka kumyinge we-A$372 million ngekota ukuya kwi-A$33 million.
📉 Iiakhawunti zabathengi abaqhelekileyo ezilahlekelwayo ezimbalwa nge-51% ngekota.
📉 Ukuvalwa kwe-margin okumbalwa nge-87%.
📉 Iziganeko zebhalansi engalunganga ezimbalwa nge-88%.

Akukho mntu waba krelekrele ngakumbi kwiinyanga ezintandathu. Uyilo lwatshintsha, kwaye isithoba kwishumi somonakalo sanyamalala nalo.

Zimbini izinto ezilandelayo, kwaye kufuneka uziphathe zombini.

Okokuqala: xa ulahlekelwa kwintengiselwano ye-leverage, uninzi lwento eyenzekileyo kuwe lwalusele lwakhiwe kumveliso phambi kokuba ufike. Oko akuyomvume yokungakhathali. Sisizathu sokuyihlonipha le nto.

Okwesibini, kwaye le yinxalenye eluncedo: ukhuseleko olwenze umsebenzi yimikhwa kanye eli candelo belikufundisa yona. Isikhundla esincinci. Ukuphuma okuzenzekelayo. Umgangatho oqinileyo womonakalo.
