78.title: Umsantsa Otsiba I-Stop Yakho
78.desc: I-stop ngumyalelo wokuphuma, hayi ixabiso elithenjisiweyo
78.content:
Sele udibene nee-stop-loss kwisifundo 19. Nantsi into eyenziwa yi-leverage kuzo.

I-stop-loss ngumyalelo: "ukuba ixabiso lifika kweli nqanaba, ndikhuphe." Asisosivumelwano malunga nexabiso oza kulifumana. Ithi phuma. Ayithi phuma kanye apha.

Uninzi lwexesha olo mahluko alubalulekanga, kuba amaxabiso ashukuma ngamanyathelo amancinci kwaye i-oda yakho igcwaliswa kufuphi nenqanaba lakho. Emva koko ngamanye amaxesha lubaluleke kakhulu.

📰 Iimarike ziyavalwa. Iindaba zifika ngo-11pm. Imarike ivula iphantsi nge-8% kunokuba ivale, kwaye ayizange irhwebe nakweliphi na ixabiso eliphakathi. I-stop yakho yayikuloo msantsa. Isebenza xa kuvulwa kwakhona size igcwaliswe naphi na apho imarike ikhona ngokwenene, okude ngaphaya kwenqanaba olikhethileyo.

Ngaphandle kwe-leverage, olo lusuku olubi. Ne-leverage, lungaba yiakhawunti yonke, kuba ukuba idiphozithi yakho yayincinci kunomsantsa, umsantsa udlula ngqo nakwixabiso lakho le-liquidation, kwaye uvalwa ngaphantsi kwenqanaba ebelijongwe yinjini.

Zintathu izinto omele uzenze ngale nto, akukho nanye inzima:

1️⃣ Musa ukuthatha i-stop njengesiqinisekiso. Yithathe njengomkhwa olunge kakhulu onobuthathaka obunye obaziwayo.
2️⃣ Yazi xa imarike yakho ivaliwe nokuba yintoni ecwangcisiweyo. Iziphumo zeenkampani, izigqibo zamazinga enzala nonyulo yimisantsa ebhalwe kwidayari.
3️⃣ Misela ubungakanani ukuze umsantsa ungakuphelisi. Lolu olona khuselo lwenene, kwaye sisifundo esilandelayo. I-stop ikukhusela kwizinto eziqhelekileyo. Ubungakanani besikhundla bukukhusela kwizinto ezingaqhelekanga, kwaye izinto ezingaqhelekanga zezona zitshayela abantu ngokwenene.

Kwaye kufanelekile ukwazi ukuba kule app, njengakuyo nayiphi na iakhawunti elawulwa ngokufanelekileyo yomthengi oqhelekileyo, ukhuseleko lwebhalansi engalunganga luthetha ukuba umsantsa awunakukusa ngaphantsi kweqanda. Ungalahlekelwa yiakhawunti. Awunakugqibela unetyala. 📰

79.title: Ubungakanani Kuqala, Emva Koko Intengiselwano
79.desc: Gqiba ukuba ungalahlekelwa yintoni phambi kokuba ugqibe ukuba uthenga ntoni
79.content:
Nantsi into eyahlula abantu abahlala ixesha elide kwabo bangahlaliyo, kwaye phantse iyadika.

Abaqalayo bakhetha intengiselwano, emva koko babale ukuba bafake malini. Oochwepheshe bakwenza ngasemva. Bagqiba kuqala ukuba bakulungele ukulahlekelwa yintoni, baze bavumele oko kugqibe ukuba isikhundla sivumelekile ukuba sikhule kangakanani.

Umthetho osetyenziswa luninzi lwabo: beka emngciphekweni i-1% ukuya kwi-2% yeakhawunti kuyo nayiphi na intengiselwano enye. Hayi ukufaka i-1% njengediphozithi. UMNGCIPHEKO we-1%, okuthetha ukuba yile nto oyilahlayo ngokwenene ukuba i-stop yakho ibethwa.

Indlela esebenza ngayo, ngamanyathelo amathathu:

1️⃣ Khetha eyona lahleko yakho iphezulu. Iakhawunti ye-10,000 NT, umngcipheko we-1%, ngoko yi-100 NT.
2️⃣ Khetha apho ungachananga khona. Uza kuphuma ukuba ixabiso lehla nge-5% ukusuka apho ungene khona.
3️⃣ Yahlula. I-100 NT yelahleko eyamkelekileyo, kumgama we-stop we-5%, ithetha isikhundla se-2,000 NT. Bubo obo ubungakanani bakho. Hayi imvakalelo. Lubalo.

Tshintsha i-stop kwaye ubungakanani butshintsha ngokuzenzekelayo. I-stop eqinileyo ye-2% ikuvumela ukuba uqhube i-5,000 NT. I-stop ebanzi ye-10% ikunyanzela ukuba wehle uye kwi-1,000 NT. Okukhona intengiselwano inobungozi, kokukhona kufuneka ibe ncinci, kwaye izibalo zikwenzela oko ukuze imo yakho ingafuneki ikwenze.

Kutheni i-1%? Kuba yenza uthotho lweelahleko lusindeke. Iilahleko ezilishumi zilandelelana kwi-1% zikushiya ne-90% yeakhawunti yakho nemo embi. Iilahleko ezilishumi zilandelelana kwi-20% zikushiya malunga ne-11% yeakhawunti yakho kungekho ndlela yokubuya, kwaye sele usazi kwisifundo 71 ukuba kunzima kangakanani oko kunyuka.

Akukho mntu usinda kwiimarike ngokukhetha abaphumeleleyo. Wonke umntu osindayo ukwenza ngokuqinisekisa ukuba akukho lahleko inye inokumphelisa. 📐

80.title: Kutheni Ukuphumelela Kuvakala Ngathi Bubuchule
80.content:
I-leverage ayisiyongxaki yemathematika ikakhulu. Imathematika ilula. Yingxaki yengqondo, kwaye nazi ezintathu ezibamba wonke umntu.

🎯 1. UKUGWEBA NGESIPHUMO (OUTCOME BIAS): ukuphumelela kuvakala ngathi bubuchule. Uthatha isikhundla esikhulu ngokugqithisileyo, siyasebenza, wenza okuninzi ngemva kwemini enye, kwaye ingqondo yakho ibhala phantsi ithi "Ndilungile kule nto." Ayizange ibhale into eyenzeke ngokwenene, ekukuba uthathe umngcipheko omubi wafumana isiphumo esihle. Ezo zizinto ezahlukeneyo, kwaye imarike iya kukuhlawula ngovuyo ngesigqibo esibi amaxesha aliqela phambi kokuba iqokelele. Eyona nto iyingozi enokwenzeka kumrhwebi omtsha kukuphumelela kwangoko, ngokulula.

😤 2. UKURHWEBA NGEZIBA (REVENGE TRADING): uyifuna ibuye, ngoku. Uyalahlekelwa, kuyabuhlungu, kwaye umnqweno ufika ngoko nangoko. Ngoko wandisa ubungakanani. Ngoku ubeka esona sikhundla sakho sikhulu kanye ngexesha apho ukugweba kwakho kukweyona meko imbi, kwintengiselwano oyikhethileyo kuba ubunomsindo kunokuba ibilungile. Imarike ayazi ukuba uphantsi kwaye ayikutyali nto. Xa uziva ngolu hlobo, ubungakanani obuchanekileyo liqanda. Vala i-app.

🕳️ 3. UKULEQA IILAHLEKO: "Ndiza kuyibamba nje de ibuye." Le inxibe njengomonde, yiyo loo nto kunzima ukuyibona. Umonde sisicwangciso osenze uzolile ngaphambili. Ukuleqa sisicwangciso osiqambe emva kokuba ixabiso likuchasile, kwaye uphawu lulula: indawo yakho yokuphuma ishukumile. Ukuba uzifumana ucacisa ukuba kutheni inqanaba obulibekile lingaselilo inqanaba elichanekileyo, olo ayiluhlalutyo olutsha. Kukuzingca kwakho kuthethathethana.

Ukhuselo kuzo zontathu luyafana kwaye alunabuqaqawuli. Gqiba yonke into ngelixa uzolile, uyibhale phantsi, uze uyithathe inguqulelo yakho evela phakathi kwentengiselwano njengombalisi ongathembekanga. 🧠

quiz.explanation: Ingqondo yakho ibhala phantsi ukuba ulungile kule nto. Eyenzeke ngokwenene kukuba uthathe umngcipheko omubi kwaye imarike yakuhlawula nje ngethamsanqa, kwaye ezo zizinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo. Imarike iya kuhlawula isigqibo esibi amaxesha aliqela phambi kokuba iqokelele. Ukuphumelela kwangoko, ngokulula yeyona nto iyingozi enokwenzeka kumrhwebi omtsha, kuba kufundisa isifundo esingalunganga kuze kukubize ngaso kamva.

81.title: Umbuzo Onyanisekileyo
81.content:
Ugqibile eli candelo. Nanku umbuzo iintengiso ezingazange ziwubuze.

Ngaba kufanele usebenzise i-leverage kwaphela?

Kuninzi lwabantu, uninzi lwexesha, impendulo enyanisekileyo ithi hayi. Hayi kuba bengakrelekrele ngokwaneleyo. Kungenxa yayo yonke into ekwizifundo ezilishumi elinesihlanu ezidlulileyo: uqala usemva, uhlawula irente ngelixa ulindile, ushukumo oluqhelekileyo lungakuphelisa phambi kokuba ubonakale uchanile, kwaye abalawuli abathathu ababala iiakhawunti zokwenyani baqhubeka befumanisa ukuba isibini kwisithathu ukuya kwisithoba kwishumi sabantu salahlekelwa.

Kukho uhlobo lorhwebo apho ungazange uchukumise nanye kwezi zinto. Uthenga isabelo, ube ngumnini wenxalenye yenkampani, iidividendi zifika, ixesha lisebenza LIKUNCEDA endaweni yokukuchasa, kwaye akukho nto inokuze ivale isikhundla sakho ingakubuzanga. Leyo yenye yonke le app, kwaye ayilokhetho oludikayo. Lukhetho olo imathematika yesifundo 14 ithi luhlala luphumelela. 🌱

Ngoko nantsi into omele uyazi phambi kokuba ugqibe.

Akukho nto kule app itshixwe ngasemva kwe-leverage. Lonke ukhuphiswano, lonke uluhlu lwabaphambili, yonke indlela ye-XP, wonke umdlalo wesikolo nawo onke amabhaso e-NOOB ahlala evulekile ngokupheleleyo kumntu ongazange avule nesinye isikhundla se-leverage. Awulahlekelwa nto ngokuphuma kule gumbi. Akukho sohlwayo kwaye akukho baji ilahlekileyo.

Kwaye akukho nto apha ikuhlawula ngokuphumelela. Uvuzwa ngokugqiba izifundo, ngokuphumelela uvavanyo, ngokubeka i-stop, ngokuvala intengiselwano elahlekelwayo, nangokubhala ingxelo yakho ye-liquidation. Awusoze uhlawulwe ngenzuzo, ngesikhundla esikhulu okanye ngothotho lwethamsanqa, kuba ukukuhlawula ngezo zinto bekuya kuba kukukufundisa into engalunganga ngelixa kubizwa ngokuba yimfundo.

Ukuba uyayisebenzisa: yisebenzise kancinci, yisebenzise ne-stop, yazi ixabiso lakho le-liquidation phambi kokuba ucofe nantoni na, kwaye ungaze uyisebenzise ngemali eya kukuvisa ubuhlungu ukuyilahla. Ukuba awuyisebenzisi, usafunde ukubona oomatshini abangasemva kwayo, nto leyo ibisoloko iyinjongo. Uninzi lwabantu abadala abarhweba ngezi zinto abanakukucacisa oko usandul' ukukufunda. 🤔

84.title: Eyona Meko Yakho Imbi, Ekhethwe Kwangaphambili
84.content:
Uyayazi idiphozithi, i-call, ukuvalwa, irente, i-stop nomsantsa. Esi sifundo sibeka iqhekeza lokugqibela endaweni yalo: sonke isikhundla oya kuze usivule siphela ngendlela enye kanye kwezintathu, kwaye wonke umdlalo ngowokuba ngubani okhethayo ukuba yeyiphi.

1️⃣ UYASIVALA WENA. Ucofa iqhosha kwaye isikhundla sivalwa kwixabiso langoku lemarike. Kuhlala kukhona, kuso sonke isikhundla, nakuyo yonke imeko. Uninzi lokuphuma kufanele kube yile.

2️⃣ I-ODA OYIBEKILEYO IYASIVALA. Iintlobo ezimbini, kwaye amagama abalulekile, ngoko wafunde kakuhle:

• I-ODA YE-STOP-LOSS ikuvala ngokuzenzekelayo xa ixabiso lishukuma LICHASENE NAWE liye kwinqanaba olikhethileyo: i-sell-stop ngaphantsi kwexabiso lakho lokungena kwi-long, i-buy-stop ngaphezulu kwexabiso lakho lokungena kwi-short. Yeyona meko yakho imbi, egqitywe ngelixa ubuzolile, nto leyo isifundo 80 sele sikufundisile ukuba kuphela kwexesha ogqiba ngalo nantoni na kakuhle.
• I-ODA YE-TAKE-PROFIT yi-limit order yokuvala: ikuvala ngokuzenzekelayo kwithagethi oyikhethileyo, xa ixabiso lishukuma LIKUNCEDA ukuze lifike kuyo. Yinto yakho ethi "kwanele", egqitywe phambi kokuba ukubawa kufumane ivoti. I-limit order igcwaliswa kwinqanaba lakho okanye ngcono, ingaze ibe mbi ngakumbi.

3️⃣ UMBONELELI UYASIVALA. Leyo yi-liquidation, evela kwisifundo 70. Kwaye nantsi into omele uyitshise engqondweni: i-liquidation ayilohlobo lwe-oda. Awunakubeka "intengiselwano ye-liquidation". Akukho mntu unako. Asisosixhobo kwikhithi yakho; yinto eyenziwa ngumboneleli ukukhusela imali-mboleko yakhe xa idiphozithi yakho iphantse yaphela, nangaliphi na ixabiso imarike elihlawulayo, ngelixa usesikolweni okanye ulele.

I-stop-loss nguwe ogqiba eyona meko yakho imbi kwangaphambili. I-liquidation yinto eyenzekayo xa ungazange ukwenze oko.

Zombini ii-oda zakho zinyanisekile ngendlela efanayo, kwaye sele uyazi kwisifundo 78: ziqala ukusebenza kwinqanaba lakho zize zigcwaliswe kwinto imarike eyihlawulayo ngokwenene. Umsantsa ngaphaya kwe-stop yakho ukugcwalisa kwelinye icala letsiba, nto leyo embi ngakumbi. Umsantsa odlula kwi-take-profit yakho ukugcwalisa kwelinye icala nalo, nto leyo ingcono. Inyani efanayo, ijonge macala omabini.

Umthetho omnye wokubeka, kwaye le app iyawunyanzelisa nesizathu kwiscreen: i-stop yakho kufuneka ihlale phakathi kwexabiso langoku nexabiso lakho le-liquidation. I-stop engaphaya kwexabiso le-liquidation ayinakuze isebenze, kuba umboneleli ebeya kukuvala kuqala, ngoko i-app iyayala kwaye ikuxelele isizathu.

Iingcango ezintathu zokuphuma kuyo yonke intengiselwano. Ezimbini zinegama lakho kwisibambo. Ukuphuma ngenye yazo, ngosuku olukhethileyo, kwinqanaba olikhethe uzolile, yile nto lonke eli candelo belikufundisa ukuyenza. 🚪

quiz.q: Isikhundla sakho se-long sine-stop-loss oyibeke kwi-180.00 nexabiso le-liquidation le-150.00. Yintoni umahluko wokwenyani phakathi kwala manani mabini?
options: Akukho nto konke konke, angamagama amabini okuvala okuzenzekelayo okufanayo, kwaye umboneleli ukwenza kwixabiso elinye qha qho ngexesha
I-stop-loss sisigqibo somboneleli kwaye ixabiso le-liquidation lelakho, ngoko lowo uwulawulayo ngokwenene nguwo osebenza wesibini
I-stop kwi-180.00 yeyona meko yakho imbi, oyikhethe ngokwakho kwangaphambili uzolile; i-150.00 yindawo umboneleli akuvala kuyo ukukhusela imali-mboleko yakhe, kuba awusenalo ilizwi
I-stop iqinisekisa ukugcwaliswa kanye kwi-180.00 nokuba imarike yenza ntoni, ngelixa i-liquidation inokugcwalisa nakweliphi na ixabiso, nokuba lihambe kude kangakanani
